en.description: The serpents of Lavos encourage him as he transmutes the battlefield. He uses Toxin, Cold, Electricity, and Heat to deal elemental damage. Harness the power of the dark alchemist.
en.name: Lavos

zh.description: 当无限术士转化战场时， 他的蛇鼓励着他。他使用毒素、冰冻、电击和火焰来造成元素伤害。掌控黑暗炼金术士的力量。
zh.name: 无限术士

en.description: Some Warframes were Prime from the start. Others ascended. Lavos, the master of transmutation, bowed to no one as he forged his own path to valor.
en.name: Lavos Prime

zh.description: 当其他战甲还在逐步提升时，有些战甲生来就是高贵的。无限术士是炼制术大师，他从不向任何人低头，而是开辟了自己的英勇之路。
zh.name: 圣装无限术士

en.description: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
en.name: Invisibility

zh.description: 邪神洛基伪装自身，让自己在敌人面前隐形。
zh.name: 隐形

en.description: Harness antimatter. Nova uses antiparticles to provide crowd control and amplify damage output. She obliterates enemies by destabilizing matter itself.
en.name: Nova

zh.description: 利用反物质。超能新星使用反物质粒子来提供群体控制并放大伤害输出。她通过使物质不稳定来消灭敌人。
zh.name: 超能新星

en.description: Launch a large particle of charged antimatter that will detonate on contact. Direct the particle by aiming, shoot it to charge it further. Deals <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>Blast Damage with a guaranteed Status Effect.
en.name: Antimatter Drop

zh.description: 发射一颗大型充能反物质粒子，触碰即引爆。通过瞄准来控制粒子方向，射击以进一步充能。造成 <DT_EXPLOSION_COLOR>爆炸伤害，并必定造成异常状态。
zh.name: 反物质释放

en.description: Primes all enemies in an expanding radius with volatile antimatter. Press the ability to slow down enemy movement, hold the ability to speed them up.
en.name: Molecular Prime

zh.description: 使用不稳定的反物质对一个不断扩大的范围内的所有敌人进行填充。按下技能键可减缓敌人移动速度，长按则加快其移动速度。
zh.name: 分子填充

en.description: Nova Prime wreaks devastation on her enemies using volatile antimatter. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Nova Prime

zh.description: 圣装超能新星以她的反物质能量波来对敌人造成破坏。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装超能新星

en.description: Creates antimatter particles that orbit Nova and attack nearby targets. Each active particle reduces damage to Nova's Health and Shields.
en.name: Null Star

zh.description: 创造反物质粒子环绕超能新星四周，并自动攻击邻近目标。每个处于活动状态的粒子都会减少对超能新星的生命值和护盾造成的伤害。
zh.name: 湮灭流星群

en.description: Creates a wormhole allowing instantaneous travel. Hold the ability to visualize placement.
en.name: Wormhole

zh.description: 创造一个虫洞以实现瞬间移动。长按此技能可预览放置位置。
zh.name: 虫洞

en.description: Creates a localized storm of punishing explosions.
en.name: Thumper

zh.description: 在指定区域中制造出一阵局部轰炸风暴。
zh.name: 轰击

en.description: Launches a plodding missile capable of unleashing a massive explosion.
en.name: Warhead

zh.description: 发射出一枚能造成大规模爆炸的慢速导弹。
zh.name: 毁灭弹头

en.description: This heavy duty Archwing was designed for one purpose, destruction.
en.name: <ARCHWING> Elytron

zh.description: 这种重型曲翼只为了一个目的而被设计出来：破坏。
zh.name: <ARCHWING> 鞘翅

en.description: Vents out the Archwing's propulsion core, confusing enemy projectiles and causing them to detonate.
en.name: Core Vent

zh.description: 将曲翼推进器核心中的气体排出，混淆并使敌方导弹引爆。
zh.name: 核心通气

en.description: Fires a high-yield, remotely detonated explosive projectile capable of latching onto targets.
en.name: Bloomer

zh.description: 发射出一枚可附着在目标上并遥控引爆的高效爆裂物。
zh.name: 高爆弹

en.description: This enhanced version of the first Archwing prototype takes the design to its theoretical limits.
en.name: <ARCHWING> Odonata Prime

zh.description: 第一架曲翼原型的强化机型，已将其设计为到理论上的极限状态。
zh.name: <ARCHWING> 圣装陨蜓

en.description: The Warframe emits a massive pulse of energy, stunning nearby enemies and sending them flying.
en.name: Repel

zh.description: 战甲放出巨大的能量脉冲，晕眩并击飞附近的敌人。
zh.name: 脉冲震波

en.description: Forms a protective energy shell around the Warframe
en.name: Energy Shell

zh.description: 形成一个围绕并保护着战甲的能量护罩。
zh.name: 能量护罩

en.description: Drops flare beacons confusing incoming guided missiles.
en.name: Disarray

zh.description: 放出可以混淆敌方导弹接近的热诱弹。
zh.name: 热诱弹

en.description: Fires a large volley of homing missiles.
en.name: Seeking Fire

zh.description: 连续发射大量导弹。
zh.name: 导弹

en.description: The systems built into this Archwing balance offensive capabilities with defensive countermeasures.
en.name: <ARCHWING> Odonata

zh.description: 这组曲翼的系统拥有均衡的攻防能力。
zh.name: <ARCHWING> 陨蜓

en.description: The Itzal Archwing teleports a short distance, dropping all enemy target locks.
en.name: Blink

zh.description: 刺影曲翼瞬移一小段距离，尽数甩开锁定了目标的敌人。
zh.name: 闪瞬

en.description: Activates a cloaking field that hides the Warframe and any nearby allies who remain stationary.
en.name: Penumbra

zh.description: 展开一道隐形力场，使静止于力场中的战甲与友军隐匿行踪。
zh.name: 半影屏蔽

en.description: Deploys drones that fight alongside the Warframe, each detonating in a destructive blast when killed.
en.name: Fighter Escort

zh.description: 部署数台无人战机于战甲身旁进行战斗，当无人战机被破坏时会造成毁灭性的爆炸。
zh.name: 护卫战机

en.description: Forms a miniature black hole that sucks in all nearby objects before rupturing in a massive shock wave.
en.name: Cosmic Crush

zh.description: 形成一个会吸进附近所有物体的微型黑洞，并在最后爆裂造成大规模的冲击震波。
zh.name: 星体震荡

en.description: Cosmic Crush Augment: The black hole saps the area of heat, freezing enemies in range. Enemies near the black hole are completely frozen for |val|s.
en.name: Cold Snap

zh.description: 星体震荡强化：黑洞可以削弱范围内的热能并完全冻结附近的敌人 |val| 秒。
zh.name: 寒流来袭

en.description: Designed for quick clandestine attacks, the Itzal Archwing excels at striking from the darkness of space.
en.name: <ARCHWING> Itzal

zh.description: 专为隐匿行动而打造，这架曲翼擅长在太空的黑暗中进行突袭作战。
zh.name: <ARCHWING> 刺影

en.description: Transform into a winged guardian.
en.name: <ARCHWING> Amesha

zh.description: 化身成一名飞翼守护者。
zh.name: <ARCHWING> 圣使

en.description: Banshee’s call heralds death. She maintains crowd control and identifies enemy weak points with sonic attacks. Few can hold their position when struck by her force.
en.name: Banshee

zh.description: 恸哭女妖的尖叫预示着死亡。她能够用声波攻击来维持群体控制和识别敌人的弱点。当她的力量袭来，几乎没有人能够站稳脚跟。
zh.name: 恸哭女妖

en.description: Banshee Prime assails her foes by manipulating sonic forces to deadly effect. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Banshee Prime

zh.description: 圣装恸哭女妖以操控声波力量造成的致死效果攻击敌人。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装恸哭女妖

en.description: Channeling all of her acoustic energy into the environment, Banshee uses ultrasonic reverberations to violently shake the ground.
en.name: Sound Quake

zh.description: 恸哭女妖将她所有的声音能量传导至周遭环境，使用超声波反响剧烈撼动目标区域的地面。
zh.name: 音波冲击

en.description: Banshee emits a sonic shockwave that pushes targets in range with enough force to incapacitate or kill attackers.
en.name: Sonic Boom

zh.description: 恸哭女妖释放一道音波冲击波，将范围内的敌人击退，使其失去战斗力并降低他们的护甲。
zh.name: 音爆

en.description: Using Silence surrounds Banshee in an aura that stuns enemies and will limit their perceptions and tactical response to gunfire and Warframe attacks.
en.name: Silence

zh.description: 使用静音会使恸哭女妖笼罩在一层光环之中，该光环会眩晕敌人，限制其对枪声和战甲攻击的感知及战术反应，并使他们无法激活自身的技能。
zh.name: 静音

en.description: Using acoustic location, Banshee's Sonar power finds and tracks enemies, and exposes critical weak spots to everyone in your squad.
en.name: Sonar

zh.description: 恸哭女妖的声纳技能可以利用声波进行定位，借以侦测及追踪敌人，并使队伍成员发觉敌人身上暴露出的致命弱点。
zh.name: 声纳

en.description: Octavia turns bass, beat, and melody into a symphony of devastation. The music of her Mandachord gives her high survivability and supports allies. Her composition means the enemy’s destruction.
en.name: Octavia

zh.description: 吟游歌者将低音、节奏和旋律编成一首毁灭的赞歌。她的曼达和弦琴音乐让她具备高度的生存能力和支援友军的能力。她谱写的歌意味着敌人的毁灭。
zh.name: 吟游歌者

en.description: Strike up a symphony of destruction with the mistress of music, Octavia, in her grandest and most spectacular form. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Octavia Prime

zh.description: 女音乐家吟游歌者，以其卓绝华美的形态，演奏毁灭的乐章。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装吟游歌者

en.description: Valkyr was modified into a highly motivated and fearsome killer. She is adept at dealing damage and surviving. Her battle cry strikes terror into all who hear it.
en.name: Valkyr

zh.description: 瓦尔基里被改造成一个动机强烈且令人恐惧的杀手。她善于造成伤害和生存下去。她的战吼让所有听到它的人感到恐惧。
zh.name: 瓦尔基里

en.description: Valkyr hurls forth a hook and pulls herself to whatever it hits. If it hits an enemy, nearby foes are pulled in as she unleashes a coordinated Melee attack.
en.name: Rip Line

zh.description: 瓦尔基里发射钩索，将自己拉向命中的目标点。如果钩索命中敌人，则附近的敌人也会被拉向目标点，同时瓦尔基里会发动一次连携近战攻击。
zh.name: 撕裂钩索

en.description: Valkyr lets out a rallying cry that bolsters Armor and Attack Speed for allies while in <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range.
en.name: Warcry

zh.description: 瓦尔基里发出激励式咆哮， 为 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内的友军增强护甲和攻击速度。
zh.name: 咆哮

en.description: Valkyr bares her deadly claws, unleashing devastating attacks that also heal her. Valkyr becomes immune to Status Effects and her Armor bonus from Warcry is multiplied while using the claws.
en.name: Hysteria

zh.description: 瓦尔基里露出致命的利爪，释放毁灭性攻击的同时治疗自身。瓦尔基里在使用利爪时免疫异常状态，且通过咆哮获得的护甲翻倍。
zh.name: 狂化爆发

en.description: Unleash a damaging blast, slowing its victims while increasing their Melee Damage Vulnerability.
en.name: Paralysis

zh.description: 释放一道破坏性的冲击波使敌人减速，并使其受到的近战伤害增加。
zh.name: 瘫痪

en.description: A proud fighter emerges unscarred by time or malice. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Valkyr Prime

zh.description: 一位经历了时间与伤痛的洗礼后依然毫发无损的高傲斗士。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装瓦尔基里

en.description: In bygone ages, mountains were said to house warriors. In this age, the mountain has become the warrior.
en.name: Atlas Prime

zh.description: 在往事如烟的时代，据说山脉是战士的容身之所。在这个时代，山脉已化身成战士。
zh.name: 圣装撼天刑者

en.description: Enemies tremble before the brawler with fists as hard as stone. Atlas deals high damage. Command terrestrial elements that form the foundation of any battlefield.
en.name: Atlas

zh.description: 在这个拳头坚硬如石头的搏击者面前，敌人瑟瑟发抖。撼天刑者可以造成高额的伤害。掌控构筑战场基石的大地之力。
zh.name: 撼天刑者

en.description: Broken Warframes adrift in the Void converged to create Xaku. Together, they deal high damage. Xaku proves that the sum of the whole is greater than its parts.
en.name: Xaku

zh.description: 漂浮在虚空中的破碎战甲汇聚在一起，形成了虚空残响。他们齐心协力，造成高额的伤害。虚空残响证明了合力的力量胜过单独的力量。
zh.name: 虚空残响

en.description: The child of war and void is reborn in gold. That which was once shattered may rise stronger than that which was never broken.
en.name: Xaku Prime

zh.description: 战争与虚空之子在黄金中重生。曾经破碎过的东西可能会比从未破碎过的东西更强大。
zh.name: 圣装虚空残响

en.description: Become enraptured by the song of devastation. Through her, the Jade Light can be a force of destruction or a source of support.
en.name: Jade

zh.description: 沉醉于毁灭之歌。通过她，翠玉之光可以成为毁灭之力，也可以成为支持之源。
zh.name: 圣天使

en.description: Albrecht Entrati designed Qorvex to protect a Chosen Operator from the unique hazards of his lab. A Crucible Core gives Qorvex high survivability as he provides crowd control.
en.name: Qorvex

zh.description: 阿尔布雷希特·英择谛设计辐能堡垒，是为了防止被选中的指挥官受到其实验室中特殊风险的危害。堆芯赋予了辐能堡垒群体控制的能力，从而使其具有强大的生存能力。
zh.name: 辐能堡垒

en.description: When activated, this power stores damage caused by guns. When triggered again, that damage is channelled through the next gunshot.
en.name: Ballistic Battery

zh.description: 启动时，这个技能会储存枪支造成的伤害。当再次启动，储存的伤害会导引至下一次射击。
zh.name: 弹道蓄能

en.description: The gunslinger has a steady deadly hand. Each shot deals high damage. Mesa is the fastest draw in the realm.
en.name: Mesa

zh.description: 枪手往往有一双稳定的死神之手。她每次射击都会造成高额伤害。圣枪弥撒是该领域最快的拔枪手。
zh.name: 圣枪弥撒

en.description: With intense focus, Mesa draws her Regulator pistols, shooting down her foes in rapid succession.
en.name: Peacemaker

zh.description: 在极度的专注之下，圣枪弥撒抽出监察者双枪，对敌人快速地连续射击。
zh.name: 和平使者

en.description: Cast a long shadow with this lethal enforcer. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Mesa Prime

zh.description: 通过这名致命的执法者投射一道长影。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装圣枪弥撒

en.description: Envelops Mesa in a barrier of energy, reflecting back incoming bullet damage.
en.name: Shatter Shield

zh.description: 圣枪弥撒笼罩在能量障壁之中，反射来袭的子弹伤害。
zh.name: 破碎护盾

en.description: Gives an ally Extra Damage while jamming the guns of nearby enemies. This power shifts between team members.
en.name: Shooting Gallery

zh.description: 为队友增加额外伤害，同时干扰附近敌人的枪支运作。这个能力会在队伍成员之间转移。
zh.name: 靶场

en.description: Never underestimate the power and wrath of sullen sadness. Dagath's malice deals high damage.
en.name: Dagath

zh.description: 永远不要低估忧怨带来的力量和怒火。无面骑影的怨恨会造成很高的伤害。
zh.name: 无面骑影

en.description: To fight as the Heretic of Xata is to have demons at your back. Uriel incinerates foes with searing brimstone, and commands three fiendish summons to do his devil’s work.
en.name: Uriel

zh.description: 以 Xata 异端者的身份战斗，意味着背后有恶魔相助。炼狱使徒用灼热的硫磺焚烧敌人，并召唤三个邪恶仆从为他效力。
zh.name: 炼狱使徒

en.description: Grendel sees every battlefield as a smorgasbord. His insatiable appetite rewards him with high survivability. Enemies will be eaten. And regurgitated.
en.name: Grendel

zh.description: 暴食者将每个战场都视为大杂烩。他贪得无厌的胃口使他具有很高的生存能力。敌人会被吃掉，然后被吐出。
zh.name: 暴食者

en.description: Primal. Insatiable. Grendel Prime devours all who oppose him.
en.name: Grendel Prime

zh.description: 原始。永不饱足。圣装暴食者吞食所有反抗他的人。
zh.name: 圣装暴食者

en.description: Bind the elements and unleash untold destruction with Chroma Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Chroma Prime

zh.description: 与元素紧密结合并发动无尽毁灭之力的圣装怒炎龙骑。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装怒炎龙骑

en.description: Unleash the draconic. Chroma employs Heat, Electricity, Toxin, and Cold to deal high damage while maintaining survivability. Soar with winged fury.
en.name: Chroma

zh.description: 释放龙之力量。怒炎龙骑使用火焰、电击、毒素和冰冻元素来造成高伤害，同时保持生存能力。以愤怒为翼，翱翔吧。
zh.name: 怒炎龙骑

zh.description: 舞霜剑姬如旋涡般降临，她的利刃锋利无比，如同凛冽的寒风。她能巧妙地运用冰霜防御，如同她迅捷的细剑攻击一般。
zh.name: 舞霜剑姬

en.description: Harness the power of fire. Ember’s heat deals high damage. She keeps a cool head when the battle is hot.
en.name: Ember

zh.description: 操纵烈焰之力。永恒烈焰的火焰会造成很高的伤害。即使战斗进入白热化时，她仍能保持冷静的头脑。
zh.name: 永恒烈焰

en.description: Ember Prime offers the same potential for wanton destruction as Ember but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.
en.name: Ember Prime

zh.description: 圣装永恒烈焰具有像永恒烈焰一样肆意破坏的潜力，但自带独特的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装永恒烈焰

en.description: Release a fiery projectile that ignites enemies on contact.
en.name: Fireball

zh.description: 释放一个燃烧的投射物，点燃接触到的目标。
zh.name: 火球

en.description: Slam the ground to create a wave of incinerating plasma that knocks back enemies and strips their armor.
en.name: Fire Blast

zh.description: 猛击地面以产生一道焚化的等离子波来将敌人击退并剥去他们的护甲。
zh.name: 火焰冲击

en.description: Stun nearby enemies with strong accelerant. Increases all fire damage dealt.
en.name: Accelerant

zh.description: 施放强力助燃可以眩晕邻近敌人，并提升对其造成的火焰伤害。
zh.name: 助燃

en.description: Blast nearby foes with a burst of fire, and follow that up with a barrage of fireballs against any enemy who dares approach. Over time, these fireballs burn hotter as they consume more energy.
en.name: World On Fire

zh.description: 用猛火爆发燃烧附近的敌人，并随之用一连串的火球打击胆敢靠近的敌人。随着时间的推移，火球将燃烧得更猛烈，也消耗更多能量。
zh.name: 火海

en.description: Nothing fancy but gets the job done and then some. With its electrified armor, this rough and ready mech can make the battlefield treacherous for the enemy with an arsenal of explosives.
en.name: Voidrig

zh.description: 虽然外表不怎么光鲜亮丽，但却能出色地完成工作。凭借其电能护甲，这款粗糙且整装待发的机甲能够携带大量爆炸物，让战场上的敌人陷入苦战。
zh.name: 虚空锐将

en.description: This fearsome Necramech, fashioned in honor of the Entrati matriarch, is a robust front-line fighter. Favoring armor and health over shield strength, Bonewidow can grab and hurl enemies, deploy a heavy shield for personal defense, and cleave through opposing ranks with a massive warblade.
en.name: Bonewidow

zh.description: 这架慑人的殁世机甲，是为了纪念英择谛的女族长而设计的，这是一个强健的前线战士。相较于护盾强度，骨骸寡妇在护甲和生命值上更占优势。她可以抓起敌人并将其猛掷出去，或是部署一个重型盾牌来进行个人防御，又或是以巨大的战刃在敌军中杀出一条血路。
zh.name: 骨骸寡妇

en.description: From the shadow of the long night emerges a new Excalibur.
en.name: DARK EXCALIBUR PRIME

zh.description: 来自长夜暗影中的新型圣剑。
zh.name: 暗影圣装圣剑

en.description: Excalibur epitomizes the warrior spirit. His master swordsmanship deals high damage. He is the embodiment of martial excellence.
en.name: Excalibur

zh.description: 圣剑是战士精神的缩影。他炉火纯青的剑术可造成高额伤害。他是卓越武学的化身。
zh.name: 圣剑

en.description: From the shadow of the long night emerges a new Excalibur.
en.name: Excalibur Umbra

zh.description: 来自长夜暗影中的新型圣剑。
zh.name: 暗影圣剑

en.description: Emit a bright flash of light, blinding all nearby enemies.
en.name: Radial Blind

zh.description: 释放一道明亮的闪光，致盲附近所有的敌人。
zh.name: 广域致盲

en.description: Radial javelins impale nearby enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
en.name: Radial Javelin

zh.description: 发射广域标枪刺穿附近的敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。
zh.name: 广域标枪

en.description: Slash and dash through enemies alongside a radial specter. The powerful Exalted Blade’s slashes inflict <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status.
en.name: Slash Dash

zh.description: 随着残影对敌人进行冲刺斩击。强大的显赫刀剑斩击造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。
zh.name: 突斩

en.description: Excalibur launches into the air, jumping 3x higher than normal.
en.name: Super Jump

zh.description: 圣剑向上弹射到空中，其跳跃高度是一般跳跃的三倍。
zh.name: 超级弹跳

en.description: Titania’s fairy-like appearance belies her formidable regal power. The enchantress deals high damage and provides crowd control. She forces opponents to pay homage or perish.
en.name: Titania

zh.description: 幻蝶仙灵仙女般的外表掩盖了她强大的统治力量。这个女魔法师可造成高额伤害并对敌人实施群体控制。她会迫使对手向她致敬，否则就会灭亡。
zh.name: 幻蝶仙灵

en.description: Tempting and terrifying, this is Titania in her ultimate form.
en.name: Titania Prime

zh.description: 诱人而又令人恐惧，这就是幻蝶仙灵的终极形态。
zh.name: 圣装幻蝶仙灵

en.description: Summons a treacherous landslide of ice that instantly freezes and shatters all enemies in its radius.
en.name: Avalanche

zh.description: 唤来变化莫测的雪崩，瞬间冻结并粉碎范围内的所有敌人。
zh.name: 雪崩

en.description: When Frost steps onto the battlefield, enemies experience a chill. Frost’s attacks control crowds, protect objectives, and increase survivability. Wield the biting cold.
en.name: Frost

zh.description: 当冰雪寒霜踏上战场时，敌人会感到一阵寒意。冰雪寒霜的攻击可以提供群体控制、保护目标，并提高生存力。驾驭刺骨的冰雪之力。
zh.name: 冰雪寒霜

en.description: Frost Prime has the same chilling abilities as Frost but provides unique mod polarities, allowing for greater customization.
en.name: Frost Prime

zh.description: 圣装冰雪寒霜拥有与冰雪寒霜一样的急冻技能，但自带独特的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装冰雪寒霜

en.description: Frost deep freezes any vapor and moisture in the area, creating a protective sphere with brief invulnerability to boost its strength.
en.name: Snow Globe

zh.description: 冻结周围所有水气与水分，制造出能用来防御的球形冰罩；冰罩生成时有短暂的无敌时间，此时敌人对冰罩造成的伤害能强化冰罩的耐久度；在相同位置重复施放冰罩可强化其耐久度。
zh.name: 冰雪护罩

en.description: Sends a wave of razor sharp, crystalized ice toward an enemy, dealing heavy damage.
en.name: Ice Wave

zh.description: 制造一道由锋利冰晶构成的冰浪来对敌人造成大量伤害及缓速效果。
zh.name: 冰浪

en.description: A frigid energy blast that freezes targets in their tracks.
en.name: Freeze

zh.description: 发射一道极度低温的能量来冻结目标。
zh.name: 冻结

en.description: Move like a shadow, strike with force. The Orokin created a Warframe that marries damage and stealth to eliminate sensitive problems, but he disappeared in the chaos of their demise. All that remains is a batch name: Cyte-09.
en.name: Cyte-09

zh.description: 身随影动，强势出击。奥罗金创造了一款结合了伤害和隐身的战甲用于解决掉一些敏感问题，但他在奥罗金灭亡的混乱之中消失了。只剩下一个批次名称：九。
zh.name: 九

en.description: Death’s crimson maiden sharpens her talons. Garuda weaponizes the blood of her foes to deal high damage. Sanguine beauty complements her deadly power.
en.name: Garuda

zh.description: 血之女王磨砺着她的利爪。迦楼罗以敌人的血液为武器，造成高额伤害。血色的美丽与她致命的力量相得益彰。
zh.name: 迦楼罗

en.description: White, gold and deepest scarlet, the queen of gore in full regalia.
en.name: Garuda Prime

zh.description: 纯白、耀金与至深猩红，血腥女王盛装登场。
zh.name: 圣装迦楼罗

zh.description: 水晶堡垒拔地而起。圣装辉光晶灵散发着令人着迷的夺目光彩，她那璀璨的宝石镶嵌在精美的金丝花纹中。
zh.name: 圣装辉光晶灵

en.description: Gaze upon the Crystal Bastion. Citrine's crystalline might supports allies on the battlefield. Combat only enhances her fractal beauty.
en.name: Citrine

zh.description: 凝视这位水晶卫士。辉光晶灵的水晶可以在战场上支持盟友。战斗只会增强她的分形之美。
zh.name: 辉光晶灵

en.description: Continue the legend of the glass-armored warrior Gara. Dominate the battlefield with the power and purity of crystal.
en.name: Gara Prime

zh.description: 身披玻璃铠甲，继承传奇战士琉璃仕女的遗志。用水晶的纯净力量统治战场。
zh.name: 圣装琉璃仕女

en.description: Enemies are made fragile by Gara’s deadly touch. Gara’s vitric abilities provide her and her allies with survivability and deal high damage. Shatter the foe.
en.name: Gara

zh.description: 琉璃仕女以致命之触让敌人变成易碎之物。琉璃仕女的玻璃技能为她和她的友军提供了生存能力，同时能造成高伤害。粉碎敌人。
zh.name: 琉璃仕女

en.description: Annihilate enemies with the conductivity of coils and transmitters. Gyre’s electric attacks provide crowd control. She is the embodiment of elegant theory.
en.name: Gyre

zh.description: 通过带电线圈与发射器的传导性来消灭敌人，电光舞者的电击可对敌人施加群体控制。她是优雅理论的化身。
zh.name: 电光舞者

en.description: Gilded circuits spark and energize frenetic movements that echo through the ages. Dance into eternity with Gyre Prime.
en.name: Gyre Prime

zh.description: 镀金电路闪烁着能量，驱动着穿越时空的狂乱舞步。与圣装电光舞者一起舞向永恒。
zh.name: 圣装电光舞者

en.description: Mirage’s sleight of hand complements her might. Her dazzled foes take heavy damage. Doppelgangers, lasers, and traps are elements of her stagecraft.
en.name: Mirage

zh.description: 魅影精灵的戏法与她的实力相得益彰。被她搞得晕头转向的敌人会受到严重伤害。分身、激光和陷阱是她舞台艺术的要素。
zh.name: 魅影精灵

en.description: Mirage creates an entourage of doppelgangers to confuse and distract the enemy.
en.name: Hall of Mirrors

zh.description: 魅影精灵创造随行的分身以混淆视听并引开敌人。
zh.name: 鬼影重重

en.description:
(TAP) Temporarily reduce the damage Mirage takes from enemies.
(HOLD) Temporarily increase Mirage's weapon damage.
en.name: Eclipse

zh.description:
（短按）暂时减少敌人对魅影精灵造成的伤害。
（长按）暂时增加魅影精灵的武器伤害。
zh.name: 黯然失色

en.description: Dazzle the opposition with this golden master of illusion and mayhem. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Mirage Prime

zh.description: 用这位精通幻术和破坏的金色大师来扰乱对手吧。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装魅影精灵

en.description: Booby trap nearby objects while conjuring an irresistible jewel that bursts with radial blind when touched in darkness, or a radial explosion in light. Conjure multiple smaller jewels with the help of Hall of Mirrors.
en.name: Sleight of Hand

zh.description: 将附近物品变成诡雷的同时变出一个令敌人难以抗拒的宝石。在黑暗处触碰宝石会爆裂造成范围致盲，在光亮处则产生范围爆炸。通过鬼影重重的帮助能施放出数个小宝石。
zh.name: 戏法

en.description: Fires an energy prism that shoots lasers in all directions. Activating again detonates the prism, blinding nearby foes.
en.name: Prism

zh.description: 放出一个四处发射激光的能量球。再次激活此技能可以引爆炸弹，并致盲附近的敌人。
zh.name: 棱镜

en.description: Styanax never wonders how many enemies he will face, only where he can find them. The hoplite deals high damage. Enemies tremble before his spear and shield.
en.name: Styanax

zh.description: 无畏斗士从不去想他要面对多少敌人，他只在乎能在何处找到他们。重装步兵可造成高额伤害。在他的长矛和盾牌的威力下，敌人闻风丧胆。
zh.name: 无畏斗士

en.description: Shield of the innocent. Spear of justice. Styanax Prime holds the line in defiance of tyranny.
en.name: Styanax Prime

zh.description: 无罪之盾，正义之矛。圣装无畏斗士坚守阵线，对抗暴政。
zh.name: 圣装无畏斗士

en.description: Nidus draws strength from the Infestation. It bolsters him with survivability as he deals high damage and provides crowd control. Plague your enemies.
en.name: Nidus

zh.description: 异变之巢从感染者中获得力量，以此造成高伤害和提供群体控制，增强了其生存能力。给你的敌人带来异变吧。
zh.name: 异变之巢

en.description: Mutation is endless. The ravening plague-bearer returns in a long-unseen form, seething with a primal strain of the Infestation.
en.name: Nidus Prime

zh.description: 永无止境的突变。贪婪的异变之源以远古之形带着原始感染菌株咆哮而来。
zh.name: 圣装异变之巢

en.description: Follie, the merry, macabre Shadowgrapher, brings ink to life. Support her squad and control enemy crowds with a myriad of versatile sketches and tricks.
en.name: Follie

zh.description: 欢愉而可怕的绘影者狂墨赋予墨水生命。她能通过千变万化的素描与戏法来支援小队，并控制敌群。
zh.name: 狂墨

en.description: Strength is Hildryn’s virtue. Her unique high-damage abilities are powered by her Shields, which can be recharged with Energy. Hildryn proves that a strong offense is a good defense.
en.name: Hildryn

zh.description: 强韧就是重装武神的长处。重装武神可从吸收自身护盾以提供能量给技能所用，同时能量亦可再次充能护盾。重装武神证明了优秀的进攻就是最佳的防守。
zh.name: 重装武神

en.description: Hildryn Prime proves that power is discipline’s reward.
en.name: Hildryn Prime

zh.description: 圣装重装武神证明了权力是纪律的回报。
zh.name: 圣装重装武神

en.description: Nyx releases a devastating psychic pulse, disorienting enemies in a wide radius and forcing them to turn on each other. Confused foes lash out at random factions.
en.name: Chaos

zh.description: 冥河夜神释放毁灭性的精神脉冲，使大范围内的敌人迷失方向，并迫使他们自相残杀。困惑的敌人会随机攻击不同派系。
zh.name: 精神混乱

en.description: Nyx unleashes a volley of psychic bolts that track and strike nearby enemies with telekinetic precision. When enemies are slain, additional bolts scatter to new targets. Striking foes weakens their defenses and transfers a portion to Nyx.
en.name: Psychic Bolts

zh.description: 冥河夜神释放出一连串精神飞刃，通过意念操控来精准追踪并攻击附近的敌人。击杀敌人后，额外的飞刃会散射到新的目标上。命中敌人会削弱他们的防御，并将一部分防御转移给冥河夜神。
zh.name: 精神飞刃

en.description: Psychic attacks make Nyx a dangerous foe. She reaches into enemy consciousness to provide crowd control and turn their attacks back on them. Such manipulation can turn the tide of battle.
en.name: Nyx

zh.description: 冥河夜神的精神攻击使她成为一个危险的对手。她通过触及敌人的意识来进行群体控制，并将他们的攻击转向他们自己。这种操纵可以扭转战局。
zh.name: 冥河夜神

en.description: Nyx seizes control of a target's mind, compelling them to fight for the Tenno cause. Controlled enemies have increased <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Status Chance. When Nyx shoots them, they also have an increased Damage Multiplier.
en.name: Mind Control

zh.description: 冥河夜神控制目标的思想，迫使他们为天诺效力。被控制的敌人会增加 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射触发几率。当冥河夜神射击他们时，伤害倍率也会增加。
zh.name: 精神控制

en.description: Infiltrate the minds of your enemies with Nyx Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Nyx Prime

zh.description: 通过圣装冥河夜神来渗透进敌人的精神中。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装冥河夜神

en.description: Nyx draws in and contains the damage dealt to her and the damage confused enemies deal to each other then converts it into a devastating radial blast. Following the blast, she enters a brief invulnerable state and gains a Weapon Damage boost proportional to the absorbed damage.
en.name: Absorb

zh.description: 冥河夜神吸收对她造成的伤害，以及困惑的敌人之间造成的伤害，然后将其转化为一道毁灭性的范围爆炸。爆炸后，她将进入短暂的无敌状态，并根据吸收的伤害增加武器伤害。
zh.name: 聚合吸收

en.description: Khora is red in whip and claw. She works together with her Kavat companion, Venari, to deal high damage and provide crowd control. Two bodies, one will.
en.name: Khora

zh.description: 荒野猎手有着血染的鞭子和爪子。她与她的库娃同伴薇娜丽，合力造成高伤害并提供群体控制。双身同心。
zh.name: 荒野猎手

en.description: A harmony of mistress and monster. The gilded huntress and her loyal Kavat, Venari, dominate the battlefield with their will.
en.name: Khora Prime

zh.description: 女能手和怪物的默契配合。镀金女猎手与她忠诚的库娃——薇娜丽，以她们的意志统治着战场。
zh.name: 圣装荒野猎手

en.description: Test your luck with the dice-maiden. Koumei weaves fate to unleash damage and ensure her survival. To the virtuous, she is an oracle. To the wicked, a perilous game of chance.
en.name: Koumei

zh.description: 让掷骰巫女试试你的运气。命运编织者御命织姬攻守兼备。对有德之人，她将带来启示；对奸邪之人，她是一场危险的博弈。
zh.name: 御命织姬

en.description: Decoy
en.name: Decoy

zh.description: 诱饵
zh.name: 诱饵

en.description: Lets forth a wave of energy, disrupting the projectile weapons of enemies in range and forcing them to revert to melee combat.
en.name: Radial Disarm

zh.description: 释放一道能量波，解除范围内敌人的射击武器，迫使他们使用近战。
zh.name: 解除武装

en.description: Loki camouflages himself, becoming invisible to enemies.
en.name: Invisibility

zh.description: 邪神洛基伪装自身，让自己在敌人面前隐形。
zh.name: 隐形

en.description: Loki knows the art of deception. The trickster employs stealth to sabotage enemies. Sow confusion.
en.name: Loki

zh.description: 邪神洛基精通欺骗的艺术。恶作剧者利用隐身来袭击敌人。制造混乱吧。
zh.name: 邪神洛基

en.description: Confuse, deceive and destroy with Loki Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Loki Prime

zh.description: 混淆、误导与破坏是圣装邪神洛基的代名词。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装邪神洛基

en.description: Loki instantaneously swaps positions with a target, confusing the enemy.
en.name: Switch Teleport

zh.description: 邪神洛基瞬间和目标交换位置，迷惑敌人。
zh.name: 移形换位

en.description:
(TAP) Enclose a target in a magnetic field that ensnares nearby enemies and deals damage over time. The field pulls Polarize Shards that orbited Mag and shrapnel into the deadly mix.
(HOLD) Mag surrounds herself in a magnetic field that absorbs ranged attacks and reflects damage back in a destructive cone.
en.name: Magnetize

zh.description:
（轻按）将目标封闭在磁场中，在一段时间内困住附近的敌人，并对其造成伤害。该磁场会吸引环绕磁力运动的「护盾极化碎片」和飞溅的弹片进行致命混合。
（长按）磁力将自己包裹在一个磁场中，吸收远程攻击，并在一个破坏性锥型域内返还伤害。
zh.name: 磁吸力场

en.description: Magnetize the bones of nearby enemies, causing them to collapse upon themselves.
en.name: Crush

zh.description: 磁化附近的敌军的骨头，导致它们自我崩坏。
zh.name: 粉碎

en.description: Take down your enemies with magnetic force. Mag alters magnetic fields to provide crowd control and strip enemy defenses. Few can resist her attraction or her repulsion.
en.name: Mag

zh.description: 运用磁力击倒你的敌人。磁力通过改变磁场来提供群体控制，同时削减敌人的防御力。几乎无人能抵挡她的吸引力或排斥力。
zh.name: 磁力

en.description: The exquisite Mag Prime offers the same abilities as Mag but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Mag Prime

zh.description: 精巧的圣装磁力拥有与磁力一样的技能，但自带独特的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装磁力

en.description: Mag stuns enemies as she manifests a magnetic vortex. The vortex pulls in Polarize Shards and stunned enemies to place them directly in front of her.
en.name: Pull

zh.description: 磁力所制造出的磁力漩涡会晕眩敌人。漩涡会将「护盾极化碎片」和被震晕的敌人拉近，并将他们放置在她面前。
zh.name: 吸引

en.description: Emit an energy pulse that depletes enemy shields and armor as it restores ally shields. Debris left over from the pulse becomes Polarize Shards. Nearby Polarize Shards orbit Mag and cut enemies, inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status Effect.
en.name: Polarize

zh.description: 发射一道能量脉冲，在耗尽敌人护盾和护甲的同时恢复队友护盾。脉冲留下的碎片会形成「护盾极化碎片」。附近的「护盾极化碎片」会环绕磁力并切割敌人，造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。
zh.name: 护盾极化

en.description: Casts a wave of Rift energy that damages hostiles while pushing enemies and allies out of Limbo's current plane of existence.
en.name: Banish

zh.description: 释放一道裂隙能量波来伤害敌人，同时将敌人与队友从灵薄狱目前所在的位面中推出去。
zh.name: 放逐

en.description: Dance between realms with this golden rift walker. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Limbo Prime

zh.description: 用这金色的裂隙行者起舞于不同的领域。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装灵薄狱

en.description: Master the rift between shadow and substance. Limbo disrupts time-space to provide crowd control. He is at home where others struggle with what is real.
en.name: Limbo

zh.description: 他掌握着影子与物质之间的裂隙。灵薄狱通过扰乱时空来进行群体控制。这是他的主场，其余人都将沉沦于虚实之间。
zh.name: 灵薄狱

en.description: Pass over into the rift plane.
en.name: Rift Walk

zh.description: 遁入裂隙位面。
zh.name: 裂隙漫游

en.description: A violent blast of Void energy tears open a pocket of rift plane which can sustain itself for a short period before collapsing in another lethal blast.
en.name: Cataclysm

zh.description: 借由虚空能量的猛烈爆炸撕开一个裂隙位面空间，此空间能短暂持续至下一次致命爆炸发生。
zh.name: 灾变

en.description: Surges nearby Rift-bound enemies with Rift energy. When killed the Rift Surge is transferred to a nearby enemy outside the rift. Surged enemies that leave the Rift perform a radial Banish.
en.name: Rift Surge

zh.description: 用裂隙能量涌流冲击附近被裂隙困住的敌人。被消灭时裂隙涌流会被传递到涌流外的一名附近的敌人上。被涌流影响的敌人若离开裂隙，将会引起一个范围​​放逐。
zh.name: 裂隙涌流

en.description: The simian warrior is a mountain of strength. Wukong deals heavy damage and has high survivability. His quick trickster tactics are unforgettable.
en.name: Wukong

zh.description: 猴族战士身体如山，力大无穷。齐天大圣能够造成巨大的伤害并具备强大的生存能力。他灵活多变的恶作剧战术让人难忘。
zh.name: 齐天大圣

en.description: The trickster-warrior ascends to his ultimate incarnation.
en.name: Wukong Prime

zh.description: 恶作剧战士提升到了他的最终形态。
zh.name: 圣装齐天大圣

en.description: Summon shadow versions of vanquished enemies to fight alongside you for a short period.
en.name: Shadows of the Dead

zh.description: 召唤已击毙敌人的幽影在短时间内一起作战。
zh.name: 亡者幽影

en.description: There is a reaper whose name is Nekros. He provides deathly crowd control. Erstwhile enemies become allies when Nekros calls up recruits from the dead.
en.name: Nekros

zh.description: 有一个收割者，他的名字叫御魂主宰。他提供致命的群体控制。当御魂主宰从死者中召唤新兵时，昔日的敌人就会变成盟友。
zh.name: 御魂主宰

en.description: Death's new master. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Nekros Prime

zh.description: 死亡的新主人。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装御魂主宰

en.description: Forces fallen enemies around you to drop additional loot.
en.name: Desecrate

zh.description: 亵渎亡者尸体，从中搜取额外物品。
zh.name: 亵渎

en.description: A blow so powerful, it turns the enemy's very soul into a deadly projectile, damaging all in its path. Enemies that survive the blow are Marked for Harvest and become one of Nekros' Shadows of the Dead if killed while marked.
en.name: Soul Punch

zh.description: 如此强烈的打击，把敌人的灵魂化为致命弹头，来杀伤其经过路线上的一切。在这一击中幸存下来的敌人会被标记以待收割，如果敌人在处于标记时被消灭，他就会成为御魂主宰「亡者幽影」中的一员。
zh.name: 灵魂重击

en.description: Cast fear into the hearts of nearby enemies, causing them to run away in terror.
en.name: Terrify

zh.description: 将恐惧感深植周遭敌人心中，使他们于恐惧之中逃窜。
zh.name: 惊骇

en.description: The mercurial firemonger protects the innocent. Nezha’s multifaceted tactics give him high survivability as he inflicts damage and provides crowd control. His fire is the clarion of hope.
en.name: Nezha

zh.description: 机敏善变的驭火行家保护无辜者。哪吒三太子多面化的战术使他在伤害和提供群体控制时具有很高的生存能力。他的火焰是希望的号角。
zh.name: 哪吒三太子

en.description: Behold: the Scion of the Burning Wind, now before you in most courtly accoutrement. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Nezha Prime

zh.description: 看呐：灼烧之风的后嗣，现在身披最典雅的战袍，出现在你面前。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装哪吒三太子

en.description: Distraction and subterfuge become lethal weapons with Ash Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Ash Prime

zh.description: 以狂乱与诡计成为致命武器的圣装灰烬之刃。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装灰烬之刃

en.description: Launches a spinning blade of pain, dealing high damage and impaling enemies to walls.
en.name: Shuriken

zh.description: 掷出一枚旋转的手里剑，造成高伤害并把敌人钉在墙上。
zh.name: 手里剑

en.description: Behold the patron saint of the Orokin school of political assassination. Ash specializes in stealth. The edge of his blade is sooner felt than seen.
en.name: Ash

zh.description: 看那奥罗金政治刺杀学派的先师圣人。灰烬之刃擅长潜行。还没见其刀光，就已命归黄泉。
zh.name: 灰烬之刃

en.description: Project fierce Shadow Clones of Ash upon groups of distant enemies. Join the fray using Teleport. The Shadow Clones can be upgraded with mods.
en.name: Blade Storm

zh.description: 将灰烬之刃的凶猛影分身投入远处的敌群中。使用「瞬移」可以主动加入这场厮杀。幻影分身可通过振幅晶体来升级。
zh.name: 剑刃风暴

en.description: Drops a smoke bomb that stuns enemies and obscures their vision, rendering Ash invisible for a short time.
en.name: Smoke Screen

zh.description: 扔出烟雾弹眩晕敌人并阻碍其视线，同时灰烬之刃进入短暂的隐身状态。
zh.name: 烟幕

en.description: Teleport to a target and perform a Finisher. If the finisher kills the target, Ash regains a portion of the energy spent.
en.name: Teleport

zh.description: 瞬移至目标并进行处决。如果处决击杀目标，将为灰烬之刃恢复一部分消耗的能量。
zh.name: 瞬移

en.description: Spring into action with Nokko! With his strong roots and an array of tricky fungi this young defender will quickly grow on you
en.name: Nokko

zh.description: 和蘑菇小子一起行动起来！这位年轻的守护者拥有强大的根系和各种古灵精怪的真菌，很快就会扎根在你的心里。
zh.name: 蘑菇小子

en.description: Protea knows all about protection. Her vast arsenal inflicts damage and provides ally support. She can even manipulate time itself.
en.name: Protea

zh.description: 泊时灵械对保护了如指掌。她庞大的武器库可以造成伤害并为友军提供支援。她甚至可以操纵时间本身。
zh.name: 泊时灵械

en.description: Behold the child of two fathers. Protea Prime once fulfilled Parvos Granum's vision of a time-wielding guardian. Now she upholds the Tenno ideal of defending the defenseless.
en.name: Protea Prime

zh.description: 看这位双父之女。圣装泊时灵械曾实现帕尔沃斯·格拉努关于操纵时间守护者的愿景。现在，她秉承天诺战士的理念，保护手无寸铁之人。
zh.name: 圣装泊时灵械

en.description: Sinister grace interwoven with lethal versatility; the evolution of a perfect predator. Fear's name is Oraxia.
en.name: Oraxia

zh.description: 阴险优雅与致命多面性交织，进化为完美掠食者。恐惧之名，缚影蛛后。
zh.name: 缚影蛛后

en.description: Doomed are the fools who attack the peace and exhaust the restraint of this reluctant warrior.
en.name: Baruuk Prime

zh.description: 那些破坏和平，以及耗尽这位不愿出手的战士克制力的愚蠢之人注定会灭亡。
zh.name: 圣装圣拳武僧

en.description: Beware the fury of the truly patient. Baruuk boasts survivability and crowd control. Pushed beyond his restraint, he unleashes the storm within.
en.name: Baruuk

zh.description: 不可小觑波澜不惊之人心中的怒火。圣拳武僧拥有出色的生存能力和群体控制能力。当忍无可忍之时，这位不愿出手的大师就会释放其内在的暴怒。
zh.name: 圣拳武僧

en.description: Seeker of knowledge. Keeper of history. Daring researcher of Leverian lore. Dante composes arcane tales to support allies and devastate enemies.
en.name: Dante

zh.description: 知识探求者。历史守护者。莱弗博物馆传说的勇敢学者。缮写士创作神秘的诗篇来支援队友并摧毁敌人。
zh.name: 缮写士

en.description: Healing and suffering do Oberon’s bidding. His command of the natural world supports allies. Boon to his friends, bane of his foes.
en.name: Oberon

zh.description: 愈合和苦痛皆为龙王奥伯所驱使。他对自然界的驾驭能够支援友军。朋友之福，敌人之祸。
zh.name: 龙王奥伯

en.description: Protect the balance with this regal forest guardian. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Oberon Prime

zh.description: 以这帝王般庄严的森林庇护者维系平衡。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装龙王奥伯

en.description: Lifts enemies into the air and then hurls them down with conviction, removing their Armor. Enemies hit by this ability will grant Oberon additional Armor and have a chance to spawn a <HEALTH>Health Orb when they die.
en.name: Reckoning

zh.description: 将附近的敌人迅速举到空中，然后将其狠狠摔下。被该技能击中的会为龙王奥伯提供额外护甲，并在死亡时有几率掉落生命球。
zh.name: 惩戒清算

en.description: Generates a protective aura that grants bonus Armor to Oberon and his allies and restores allies’ Health over time. Healing is doubled while within the radius of Hallowed Ground.
en.name: Renewal

zh.description: 生成一道保护光环，为龙王奥伯及其友军提供护甲加成，并持续恢复友军生命值。在「神圣领域」范围内，治疗效果翻倍。
zh.name: 疗愈脉动

en.description: Focuses deadly energy within a target, dealing massive damage and removing all of its defenses, including Overguard. Enemies near the target also take a portion of the damage.
en.name: Smite

zh.description: 将致命能量聚集于目标，造成巨大伤害并移除其所有防御，包括超宏防护。目标附近的敌人也会受到部分伤害。
zh.name: 惩击

en.description: Sanctifies the ground around Oberon, inflicting <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage to all enemies within the radius. Also grants protection against Status Effects for Oberon and his allies.
en.name: Hallowed Ground

zh.description: 圣化龙王奥伯周围的地面，对范围内的所有敌人造成 <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。同时保护龙王奥伯及其友军免受异常状态影响。
zh.name: 神圣领域

en.description: Kullervo answers for his sins and the sins of others. His daggers and melee prowess deal high damage. Seize the power of treachery to slake his thirst for revenge.
en.name: Kullervo

zh.description: 刀锋囚徒背负着自己和他人的罪孽。他的匕首和近战能力可以造成高额伤害。抓住背叛的力量来满足他对复仇的渴望。
zh.name: 刀锋囚徒

en.description: Summon a tempest to rain down upon a target area.
en.name: Tempest Barrage

zh.description: 召唤暴风雨弹炮轰目标区域。
zh.name: 暴风雨弹幕

en.description: Command the ocean's fury with this king of gold and silver. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Hydroid Prime

zh.description: 以这金银之王号令大海的怒涛。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装惊涛骇浪

en.description: Summon a creature from the depths. Its watery tentacles emerge from nearby surfaces to wreak havoc.
en.name: Tentacle Swarm

zh.description: 召唤一只来自深海的生物。它的水之触手从四面八方席卷而来造成严重破坏。
zh.name: 触角肆虐

en.description: Become a water trap and drown unsuspecting enemies.
en.name: Undertow

zh.description: 用水漩涡淹没毫无防备的敌人。
zh.name: 水漩涡

en.description: Hydroid summons the power of the ocean depths. He provides crowd control with aqueous attacks. His enemies will meet a watery demise.
en.name: Hydroid

zh.description: 惊涛骇浪可以召唤海洋深处的力量。他通过水系攻击来提供群体控制。他的敌人将在水中消亡。
zh.name: 惊涛骇浪

en.description: Crash through enemies in a ferocious wall of water.
en.name: Tidal Surge

zh.description: 用凶猛的水墙冲垮敌人。
zh.name: 潮汐浪涌

en.description: Warframe punches the ground, dealing high damage to enemies in a small radius.
en.name: Radial Blast

zh.description: 战甲震击地面，在小范围内对敌人造成大量伤害。
zh.name: 冲击波

en.description: The Inquisitor Eternal arises, hallowed by the Void, preaching a gospel of iron and flame.
en.name: Harrow Prime

zh.description: 永恒的审判官已经崛起，受虚空洗礼，吟诵铁与火的福音。
zh.name: 圣装驱魔使者

en.description: Achieve redemption through vengeance. The monastic Harrow increases damage to support allies. Defy enemies and ascend.
en.name: Harrow

zh.description: 通过复仇来实现救赎。僧侣般的驱魔使者会增幅友军的杀伤力，为其提供支援。克敌制胜，超越自我。
zh.name: 驱魔使者

en.description: As regal and lethal as a nighttime wood, this is the queen of the hunt in her ultimate form.
en.name: Ivara Prime

zh.description: 像夜间的树林一样庄严与致命，这就是狩猎女王的终极形态。
zh.name: 圣装神弓游侠

en.description: The huntress draws her bow. Ivara is stealth itself. Her enemies live in fear of her sudden attacks.
en.name: Ivara

zh.description: 女猎手拉动了她的弓箭。神弓游侠善于潜行。她的敌人时刻被她突袭的恐惧所笼罩。
zh.name: 神弓游侠

en.description: Macabre spectral power has risen. Infused with the essence of the Eidolon, Revenant has strong survivability and deals high damage. Enemies become his thralls.
en.name: Revenant

zh.description: 恐怖的恶灵之力已经涌现。融合了夜灵本质的徘徊夜灵，拥有强大的生存能力和高额伤害。敌人皆成为他的奴仆。
zh.name: 徘徊夜灵

en.description: The lost one rises. Reify the essence of the Eidolon as you wield Revenant Prime’s power.
en.name: Revenant Prime

zh.description: 迷失者之崛起。使用圣装徘徊夜灵的力量，来具象化夜灵之力。
zh.name: 圣装徘徊夜灵

en.description: Rhino hardens his skin, insulating himself from all damage and gaining Overguard.
en.name: Iron Skin

zh.description: 狂野犀牛硬化他的皮肤，隔绝一切伤害并获得超宏防护。
zh.name: 钢化皮肤

en.description: Grants all nearby Warframes increased damage for a short duration.
en.name: Roar

zh.description: 短时间内让所有附近的战甲提升伤害输出。
zh.name: 战吼

en.description: Rhino packs a punch. He boasts high survivability and crowd control. The wise would do well to stand clear when he charges.
en.name: Rhino

zh.description: 狂野犀牛重拳以待。他拥有很高的生存能力和群体控制技能。当他冲锋时，明智的人都会选择不要站在他的对面。
zh.name: 狂野犀牛

en.description: Rhino charges towards a target, clobbering any in his path and goring his victim.
en.name: Rhino Charge

zh.description: 狂野犀牛向目标冲锋，击倒突进路径上的一切阻碍，并以犀角强烈顶击目标。
zh.name: 犀牛冲锋

en.description: Takes Rhino's ground-shaking abilities to the next level with altered mod polarities that offer greater customization.
en.name: Rhino Prime

zh.description: 通过将极性插槽改为更适合自定的配置，使狂野犀牛地面震动能力发挥到更高水平。
zh.name: 圣装狂野犀牛

en.description: Rhino stomps with force sufficient to disrupt time, tumbling enemies around him in stasis.
en.name: Rhino Stomp

zh.description: 狂野犀牛的强力践踏可以扰乱时间秩序，将周围的敌人锁定在时间中。
zh.name: 犀牛践踏

en.description: Quicksilver takes form. Gauss Prime brooks no talk of defeat.
en.name: Gauss Prime

zh.description: 以水银打造的外型。圣装迅电驰影不容失败。
zh.name: 圣装迅电驰影

en.description: Take charge with the Saint of Altra. Gauss is fast, deals high damage, and has strong survivability. Movement charges his powerful battery, so never stop moving.
en.name: Gauss

zh.description: 与阿尔特拉的圣者一同主宰战场。迅电弛影速度快，伤害高，生存能力强。移动可以为他的强大电池充电，因此绝不停下脚步。
zh.name: 迅电驰影

en.description: Rise, eternal, to cast the fear of Inaros into them. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Inaros Prime

zh.description: 唤醒这永恒的存在，以此来把沙海怒涛带来的恐惧施加到他们身上。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装沙海怒涛

en.description: Inaros commands the fearsome desert. He survives like the ever-shifting sands that empower him. Legend recalls Inaros as the Fear-Eater.
en.name: Inaros

zh.description: 沙海怒涛统领着骇人的沙漠。他的生存之道如同赋予他力量的千变万化的沙漠。传说中的沙海怒涛是恐惧的吞噬者。
zh.name: 沙海怒涛

en.description: Saryn pollutes the atmosphere with a lethally poisonous mist that corrodes all enemies in range. Deals additional Damage to enemies under <DT_POISON_COLOR>Toxin and <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral effects.
en.name: Miasma

zh.description: 剧毒之触以剧毒之雾污染空气，腐蚀范围内的敌人。依据敌人所受到的毒素与病毒影响受到额外伤害。
zh.name: 瘴气

en.description: Inflicts target with <DT_VIRAL_COLOR>Viral Damage over time. Destroying the spore will spread it to nearby enemies.
en.name: Spores

zh.description: 对目标造成 <DT_VIRAL_COLOR> 持续的病毒伤害；摧毁孢子时会扩散至邻近敌人身上。
zh.name: 毒性孢子

en.description: Toxicity is Saryn’s strength. Her serpentine powers deal heavy damage. For Saryn, venom is a virtue.
en.name: Saryn

zh.description: 剧毒是剧毒之触的强项。她蛇一般的能力会造成巨大伤害。对剧毒之触来说，毒液是一种美德。
zh.name: 剧毒之触

en.description: A golden blossom conceals deadly nectar. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Saryn Prime

zh.description: 一朵隐藏着致命花蜜的金花。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装剧毒之触

en.description: Shedding her skin like a snake, Saryn leaves a decoy behind to draw fire from enemies.
en.name: Molt

zh.description: 剧毒之触脱落如蛇般的皮肤，在身后留下诱饵吸引敌人的火力。
zh.name: 蜕皮

en.description: When active, melee strikes burst spores causing them to spread to nearby enemies.
en.name: Toxic Lash

zh.description: 施放时，近战攻击会引爆孢子使其扩散到附近的敌人。
zh.name: 剧毒鞭笞

en.description: Forged in celebration of the all-too-brief peace between the Orokin and Sentients, Caliban Prime is a true collaborative masterpiece. The heir of twin kingdoms arises in royal gold.
en.name: Caliban Prime

zh.description: 圣装卡利班是为了庆祝奥罗金帝国与灵煞之间短暂的和平而打造的，堪称真正的合璧杰作。双生王国的继承者，身披皇家之金崛起。
zh.name: 圣装卡利班

en.description: The heir of twin kingdoms ascends. Biological and Sentient life meet in Caliban. An adept monarch, he offers crowd control and survivability. His creator had more than one world in mind.
en.name: Caliban

zh.description: 双生王国的继承人登场。生物与灵煞形态在卡利班身上交汇。作为一名老练的君主，他可以对敌人实施群体控制和并拥有极强的生存能力。他的创造者心中有不止一个世界。
zh.name: 卡利班

en.description: Wield the power of the stars in a constant battle for supremacy. The dueling sons, Sirius & Orion, occupy the space of a single Warframe, jockeying for position to rain cosmic destruction upon foes.
en.name: Sirius & Orion

zh.description: 在永无休止的霸权争夺战中，驾驭星辰之力。西里斯与奥里昂这对决斗之子，在同一个战甲中，彼此角力，争相占据有利位置，向敌人倾泻宇宙级的毁灭之力。
zh.name: 西里斯&奥里昂

en.description: Blazing with glamor and armed with an Infested guitar, Lizzie, Temple’s power chords light the flames of revolution.
en.name: Temple

zh.description: 魅力四射的赤焰狂歌，手持他的感染吉他：丽兹，用强力的和弦点燃了革命的火焰。
zh.name: 赤焰狂歌

en.description: Hold while airborne to hover Zephyr with reduced movement. From the air, tap to dash forward, or aim down to dive bomb enemies below.
en.name: Tail Wind

zh.description: 在空中按住技能键，来使狂啸西风悬停并减慢移动速度。在空中时，轻按技能键来向前冲刺，或是瞄准地面对下方的敌人使出俯冲轰击。
zh.name: 顺风

en.description: Command the power of the wind. Zephyr’s cyclonic abilities protect her, deal high damage, and provide crowd control. She swoops in from above and leaves a path of destruction.
en.name: Zephyr

zh.description: 掌控风之力量。狂啸西风的旋风技能可以保护她、造成高伤害并提供群体控制。她从上方俯冲而下，留下一条毁灭之路。
zh.name: 狂啸西风

en.description: Create deadly tornadoes that seek out and engulf enemies. Tornadoes deal the elemental Damage Type they absorb the most. Shoot engulfed enemies to inflict extra damage. Hold for stationary tornadoes or tap for wandering ones.
en.name: Tornado

zh.description: 制造致命的「龙卷云风」，四处搜寻并吞没敌人。「龙卷云风」会造成它们所吸收最多的元素伤害类型。射击被吞没的敌人来造成额外伤害。长按制造固定不动的「龙卷云风」，轻按则制造游走的「龙卷云风」。
zh.name: 龙卷云风

en.description: Creates a wind shield around Zephyr, redirecting all incoming projectiles.
en.name: Turbulence

zh.description: 围绕狂啸西风生成一个风护盾，把所有射进来的子弹都偏转到其他方向。
zh.name: 疾风湍流

en.description: Take to the skies with this golden bird of destruction.
en.name: Zephyr Prime

zh.description: 用这只富有破坏力的金色小鸟飞向天空。
zh.name: 圣装狂啸西风

en.description:
Control the battlefield with masterful mines. Vauban's Tether-Flechette orb immobilizes and draws in enemies while launching deadly nails in all directions.

HOLD to launch a Vector-Overdrive pad that accelerates foes and allies alike in the pad's direction, increasing ally Movement Speed and Weapon Damage.
en.name: Minelayer

zh.description:
用精妙的地雷掌控战场。工程统帅的桎梏飞掷丸能束缚并吸引敌人，同时向四面八方发射致命的飞镖。

按住即可发射矢量超载垫，为垫子方向上的敌我双方加速，并提升友军的移动速度和武器伤害。
zh.name: 布雷器

en.description:
Erect a containment field to capture enemies and suspend them in stasis, stripping their armor and granting it to Vauban and any allies within Bastille's field.

HOLD to collapse all Bastilles into a single damaging vortex.
en.name: Bastille

zh.description: 建立一个包围力场以捕获敌人使他们陷入停滞状态，剥离其护甲并将其转移给工程统帅和「力场牢狱」范围内的所有友军。 长按技能键来使所有力场牢狱坍塌成为一个破坏性旋涡。
zh.name: 力场牢狱

en.description: Creates a whirling mass of energy that violently attracts nearby enemies, crushing their atoms into a tiny spec of matter.
en.name: Vortex

zh.description: 创造一个大规模旋转的能量，猛烈牵引附近敌人，粉碎他们的原子成微小物质。
zh.name: 旋涡

en.description: Vauban is the model of innovative technology. He deploys clever inventions to provide crowd control. His tenacity and focus make him formidable.
en.name: Vauban

zh.description: 工程统帅是创新技术的典范。他会通过巧妙的部署来对敌人造成群体控制。他的坚韧和专注使他令敌人生畏。
zh.name: 工程统帅

en.description: Transform the battlefield into a weapon with this gilded tactician. Features unique mod polarities for extended customization.
en.name: Vauban Prime

zh.description: 使用这位镀金的战术大师来将战场转变成你的武器吧！该战甲拥有​​着特化过的振幅晶体极性槽来提供更佳的自定可能性。
zh.name: 圣装工程统帅

en.description: Deploy a roller drone that attaches itself to enemies and delivers bursts of arcing <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR> Electricity Damage to anything in the immediate area.
en.name: Tesla Nervos

zh.description: 部署一架可以将自身附着在敌人身上的滚子无人机，并向附近区域的任何物体发出炸裂电弧，造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。
zh.name: 特斯拉电激

en.description: Restore the health and shields of allies within <AFFINITY_SHARE>Affinity Range while reducing the damage they take from enemies.
en.name: Blessing

zh.description: 恢复 <AFFINITY_SHARE>经验共享范围内友军的生命值和护盾，同时减少他们受到的敌人伤害。
zh.name: 祝福

en.description: Allies will gain energy over time when enemies are marked with Energy Vampire.
en.name: Energy Vampire

zh.description: 友军将在伤害被能力吸取标记的敌人同时获得能量。
zh.name: 能量吸取

en.description: Any damage taken while Link is active will be channeled to a nearby enemy.
en.name: Link

zh.description: 链接激活时，一切受到的伤害将转移给身边的一个敌人。
zh.name: 链接

en.description: Trinity embodies redemption and health. Her extraordinary healing powers support allies. Where others destroy, she restores.
en.name: Trinity

zh.description: 三位一体体现了救赎与治愈。她非凡的治疗技能可为队友提供强力支持。被他人破坏之处，她可治愈。
zh.name: 三位一体

en.description: Become the bastion that defends allies using powerful healing abilities with Trinity Prime. Featuring altered mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Trinity Prime

zh.description: 圣装三位一体操控强大的治愈能力，成为捍卫友军的壁垒。拥有改造过的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装三位一体

en.description: Create a well of life on an enemy who will absorb Status Effect damage intended for nearby allies. Allies gain additional Health when they attack the target. If allies die, enemies in the well of life die in their stead.
en.name: Well of Life

zh.description: 在敌人身上创造一道生命之井，吸收附近队友受到的异常状态伤害。队友攻击目标时可获得额外生命值。如果队友死亡，生命之井中的敌人将代替他们死亡。
zh.name: 生命之井

en.description: Volt discharges the electricity that courses through him. The shockwave paralyzes and damages nearby enemies. Enemies on the edge of the shockwave are stunned.
en.name: Discharge

zh.description: 伏特会释放流淌全身的电流。冲击波会麻痹并伤害附近的敌人。处在冲击波边缘的敌人则会被击晕。
zh.name: 电能释放

en.description:
Volt deploys an electric shield that blocks enemy fire and adds <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Damage to projectiles.
 
HOLD to equip the shield for mobile cover.
en.name: Electric Shield

zh.description:
伏特部署一个电力屏障，能阻挡敌方火力，并对投射物附加<DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击伤害。

长按可装备屏障，作为移动掩护。
zh.name: 电力屏障

en.description: Launch a voltaic projectile that stuns and damages its target. A chain of electricity extends from the target to shock nearby enemies.
en.name: Shock

zh.description: 发射一个能击晕并伤害目标的伏电射弹。一串电弧以目标为中心，散发式电击附近的敌人。
zh.name: 电击

en.description: Embody an electric current. Volt and his allies receive a brief movement speed boost and a reload speed buff.
en.name: Speed

zh.description: 显现一支电流。伏特与其队友会获得短暂的移动速度和装填速度增益。
zh.name: 加速

en.description: Electricity flows through Volt. His attacks deal high damage. Enemies will be shocked.
en.name: Volt

zh.description: 电流在伏特身上涌动。他的攻击可造成高额伤害，并震慑敌人。
zh.name: 伏特

en.description: A glorious warrior from the past, Volt Prime features the same abilities as Volt but with unique mod polarities for greater customization.
en.name: Volt Prime

zh.description: 一位来自过去的荣耀战士，圣装伏特拥有与伏特一样的技能，但自带独特的振幅晶体极性槽，可提供更优秀的自定义空间。
zh.name: 圣装伏特

en.description: Splendor and ferocity reach their savage apex in Voruna Prime. Though exalted by Orokin gold, she is more feral than ever.
en.name: Voruna Prime

zh.description: 辉煌与凶猛在圣装赤影狼母身上达到了顶峰。虽然她被奥罗金黄金所装饰，却比以往任何时候都更具野性。
zh.name: 圣装赤影狼母

en.description: Four beasts, one heart. Voruna's loyal wolf pack makes for a deadly combination of strength and stealth. Beware the monstrous howl that heralds fangs of vengeance.
en.name: Voruna

zh.description: 四头野兽，同心一颗。赤影狼母的忠诚狼群是力量与隐秘的致命结合。当心那伴随着可怕嚎叫的复仇獠牙。
zh.name: 赤影狼母

en.description: Wisp floats between the material and the ethereal. She accesses multiple dimensions to support her allies. Her countenance is mysterious and enigmatic.
en.name: Wisp

zh.description: 离火幻灵游走于物质和虚无之间。她可以进入多个维度，为友军提供支援。她的面容神秘莫测，让人捉摸不透。
zh.name: 离火幻灵

en.description: Wisp Prime’s gilded splendor haunts the battlefield. Allies welcome her interdimensional beauty.
en.name: Wisp Prime

zh.description: 圣装离火幻灵的镀金光彩萦绕在战场上。盟友也十分期待她的多维美貌。
zh.name: 圣装离火幻灵

en.description: The gilded helmsman emerges from the tempest, his shadow a lure for doomed souls.
en.name: Sevagoth Prime

zh.description: 镀金舵手从暴风雨中现身，他的身影吸引着注定悲怆的灵魂。
zh.name: 圣装虚冥鬼影

en.description: No longer adrift in the Void, Sevagoth has returned. He and his Shadow deal heavy damage and have high survivability. They are sustained by the reaping of wayward souls.
en.name: Sevagoth

zh.description: 虚冥鬼影不再漂泊虚空，已经回归。他和他的幽影能够造成巨大的伤害，并具有极强的生存能力。他们通过收割那些迷途的灵魂来维持自身的力量。
zh.name: 虚冥鬼影

en.description: The waverider can unleash a flood of destruction on the battlefield. Yareli’s aqueous attacks deal high damage. Surf’s up. Enemies down.
en.name: Yareli

zh.description: 驭浪者可以在战场上释放出毁灭的洪流。咏浪之灵的水系攻击可对敌人造成高额伤害。驭浪而上，敌军溺亡。
zh.name: 咏浪之灵

en.description: The Waverider arises, reborn from the ocean foam. In her original Orokin-era splendor she embodies the undying vigor of youth.
en.name: Yareli Prime

zh.description: 驭浪者从海浪中重生。她以奥罗金时代的风采，体现出青春不朽的活力。
zh.name: 圣装咏浪之灵

en.description: Night and Day in final balance; the graceful perfection of the one that walks the borders.
en.name: Equinox Prime

zh.description: 昼夜的最终平衡形态；行走于界线上的优美之型。
zh.name: 圣装阴阳双子

en.description: Equinox rises from the edge of day and night. Her Day form offers offensive support while her Night form offers defensive support. She thrives between realms.
en.name: Equinox

zh.description: 阴阳双子从白昼与黑夜的边缘崛起。她的白昼形态提供攻击支援，她的黑夜形态提供防御支援。她在白昼与黑夜之间来回游走。
zh.name: 阴阳双子

en.description: The kubrow sniffs out buried objects and digs them up.
en.name: Dig

zh.description: 库狛嗅出被埋藏的道具并挖掘出来。
zh.name: 挖掘

en.description: Fires volleys of icy grenades that inflict a lingering chill on the blast zone.
en.name: Cryotra

zh.description: 发射一连串冰冷的手榴弹，在爆炸区域留下持久的寒气。
zh.name: 急冻喷枪

en.description: Launches a volley of bomb darts that embed themselves in targets, exploding a short time later.
en.name: Multron

zh.description: 发射一连串炸弹飞镖，嵌入目标中并在短时间后爆炸。
zh.name: 多连穿甲枪

en.description: Launches a swarm of micro-missiles.
en.name: Helstrum

zh.description: 发射密集的微型导弹。
zh.name: 赫尔斯壮

en.description: Releases a burst of static electricity that can jump between foes, incapacitating them.
en.name: Tazicor

zh.description: 释放出一阵静电，该静电可以在敌人之间跳跃，使他们失去战斗能力。
zh.name: 泰瑟步枪

en.description: Charges up a powerful blast of ultra-heated plasma.
en.name: Vulcax

zh.description: 可蓄能发射出强力爆发的极热电浆。
zh.name: 金工火舌

en.description: Hound melee attacks pierce hard with <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact and <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture Damage.
en.name: Batoten

zh.description: （英文：BATOTEN）猎犬近战攻击通过 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击和 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺伤害猛烈穿刺。
zh.name: 巴托腾

en.description: Hound melee attacks devastate with <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>Impact and <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage.
en.name: Lacerten

zh.description: （英文：LACERTEN）猎犬近战攻击通过 <DT_IMPACT_COLOR>冲击和 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害进行毁灭。
zh.name: 莱斯腾

en.description: Hound melee attacks eviscerate with <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>Puncture and <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage.
en.name: Akaten

zh.description: （英文：AKATEN）猎犬近战攻击通过 <DT_PUNCTURE_COLOR>穿刺和 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害开膛剖腹。
zh.name: 阿卡腾

en.description: Teshin’s twin blades. Power Strike sends forth two arcs of energy that inflict <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>Electricity Status.
en.name: Sun & Moon

zh.description: 泰辛的双侍刃。使用强力攻击可发出两道造成 <DT_ELECTRICITY_COLOR>电击异常状态的爆炸性能量弧。
zh.name: 赤阳 & 幽月

en.description: Teshin's twin blades.
en.name: Sun & Moon

zh.description: 泰辛的双侍刃。
zh.name: 赤阳 & 幽月

en.description: Diriga shocks nearby enemies, and picks off distant threats, utilizing the Vulklok sniper rifle and the 'Calculated Shot', 'Arc Coil' and 'Electro Pulse' precepts.
en.name: Diriga

zh.description: 电气浮囊会电击附近的敌人，并针对远处的威胁目标进行攻击。使用「金工火枪」狙击步枪与「精算射击」、「电弧线圈」与「电光脉冲」等独特技能。
zh.name: 电气浮囊

en.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Ammo Case' as default Precepts, Carrier is a seeker Sentinel. Carrier also comes with a shotgun weapon.
en.name: Carrier

zh.description: 以「突击模式」和「弹药储转箱」为预设指令，搬运者是一个前锋守护，并配备一把霰弹枪。
zh.name: 搬运者

en.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube acts exactly as advertised, as a badass cube of 'deth'. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle weapon.
en.name: Dethcube

zh.description: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」为预设指令，死亡魔方就像广告宣传的那样，是一个带来死亡的超棒魔方，内置死亡机枪。
zh.name: 死亡魔方

en.description: With 'Auto Omni' and 'Cordon' as default Precepts, this Sentinel is the ideal companion for long voyages aboard a Railjack.
en.name: Nautilus

zh.description: 以「万用自修」和「防线封锁」为默认指令，这件守护是搭乘航道星舰远航的理想同伴。
zh.name: 鹦鹉螺

en.description: With 'Thumper' and 'Fatal Attraction' as default Precepts, Djinn is a combat Sentinel. Djinn also comes with a poison dart weapon.
en.name: Djinn

zh.description: 以「重击者」和「致命诱惑」为预设指令，引灵是一个战斗守护，还配备了毒镖武器。
zh.name: 引灵

en.description: With 'Investigator' as its unique Precept and 'Deconstructor' as its weapon, the versatile Helios Sentinel acts as both a lethal guardian and an automatic codex scanner. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.
en.name: Helios

zh.description: 赫利俄斯拥有独特的「侦查」指令并以「分离」作为武器，这位多功能的守护既是致命的守护者，又是资料库的自动扫描器。扫描功能须在身上携带扫描器，且扫描器有可使用的扫描次数才能触发。
zh.name: 赫利俄斯

en.description: This brave deckhand defends his crew with Verglas Prime.
en.name: Nautilus Prime

zh.description: 这位勇敢的水手使用圣装冰凇来保护他的船员。
zh.name: 圣装鹦鹉螺

en.description: This ornate sentinel is an excellent example of late Orokin craftsmanship and styling.
en.name: Carrier Prime

zh.description: 这架华丽的守护是呈现奥罗金晚期工艺与风格极佳的范例。
zh.name: 圣装搬运者

en.description: With 'Assault Mode' and 'Vaporize' as default precepts, Dethcube Prime is the apex of lethal support. Comes loaded with Deth Machine Rifle Prime weapon.
en.name: Dethcube Prime

zh.description: 以「突击模式」和「汽化」作为预设指令，圣装死亡魔方是致命支援的巅峰。其标配武器为圣装死亡机枪。
zh.name: 圣装死亡魔方

en.description: This knowledge hungry protector defends its master with Deconstructor Prime.
en.name: Helios Prime

zh.description: 这个充满求知欲的守护与圣装分离一同防卫着它们的主人。
zh.name: 圣装赫利俄斯

en.description: Shade Prime specializes in stealth and comes locked and loaded with the Burst Laser Prime. Together, you can dominate the shadows.
en.name: Shade Prime

zh.description: 圣装阴影专长隐形，它装载了圣装激光点发。和它一同主宰暗影吧。
zh.name: 圣装阴影

en.description: Both bodyguard and status symbol, the Wyrm Prime Sentinel was the last line of defense for high ranking Tenno in the Orokin Era.
en.name: Wyrm Prime

zh.description: 保镖与地位的象征，在奥罗金时代中，蛟龙守护圣装是高阶天诺战士的最后一道防线。
zh.name: 圣装蛟龙

en.description: A rare jewel of the void. How could anything so beautiful be crafted for stealth?
en.name: Prisma Shade

zh.description: 虚空中的一种稀有珍宝。怎有如此美丽宝物竟是为潜行锻造？
zh.name: 棱晶·阴影

en.description: With 'Scan Aquatic Lifeforms' and 'Scan Matter' as default Precepts, Oxylus was designed to assist in Search-and-Rescue operations through the harsh landscape around The Orb Vallis. Oxylus also comes with a Multron rifle.
en.name: Oxylus

zh.description: 以「扫描水生生命体」和「扫描物质」为默认指令，奥克绪罗斯被设计用于奥布山谷外围严酷环境的搜救行动。奥克绪罗斯拥有一把多连穿甲枪。
zh.name: 奥克绪罗斯

en.description: With 'Revenge' and 'Ghost' as default Precepts, Shade is well suited for stealth gameplay. Shade also comes with a burst laser pistol.
en.name: Shade

zh.description: 以「复仇」和「幽灵」为预设指令，非常适合隐匿型玩法，并同时具备点放式激光手枪。
zh.name: 阴影

en.description:
To cosmic forms from tangent planes

We end as we began
en.name: Khra

zh.description:
对于从相切位面演化出的宇宙来说

我们的结局又回到了开始
zh.name: 时间

en.description:
In luminous space blackened stars

They gaze, accuse, deny
en.name: Ris

zh.description:
光明的太空之中，飘荡着焦黑的星辰

它们凝视、指责、否认
zh.name: 光明

en.description:
To cosmic madness laws submit

Though stalwart minds entreat
en.name: Vome

zh.description:
面对疯狂的宇宙，法则选择了屈服

但那些坚定之人却前去乞求
zh.name: 秩序

en.description:
From brooding gulfs are we beheld

By that which bears no name
en.name: Lohk

zh.description:
来自沉思之渊的视线，落在了我们身上

其源头为无名之物
zh.name: 虚空

en.description:
Carrion hordes trill their profane

Accord with eldritch plans
en.name: Netra

zh.description:
腐朽的大军以亵渎的口吻

吟唱着古老的计划
zh.name: 衰退

en.description:
Roiling, moaning, this realm of ours

In madness lost shall die
en.name: Fass

zh.description:
我们的世界，沸腾着，呻吟着

在癫狂之中，等待迷失者的只有死亡
zh.name: 混乱

en.description:
Corporeal laws are unwrit

As suns and love retreat
en.name: Jahu

zh.description:
定律归零

太阳和爱退缩
zh.name: 形态

en.description:
Its heralds are the stars it fells

The sky and Earth aflame
en.name: Xata

zh.description:
掉落的星辰是它到来的先兆

天地燃烧
zh.name: 真理

en.description:

en.description: The dual flaming fang-blades of the Archon Amar. Has a unique Neutral Combo that blasts out four short-range fireballs.
en.name: Nepheri

zh.description: 执刑官欺谋狼主的烈焰双刃。其独特的近战组合可以发射四个短程火球。
zh.name: 赤炎流星

en.description: Archon Boreal’s signature trident. Thrust Korumm into the ground with a Tactical Combo and then rip it out in a shower of electricity.
en.name: Korumm

zh.description: 执刑官诡文枭主的标志性三叉戟。战术组合可以将雷霆暴君插入地面，并在拔出时造成电击。
zh.name: 雷霆暴君

en.description: Archon Nira’s spine-shattering whip. Has a unique Tactical Combo that whips out a wide wave of energy with each stroke.
en.name: Verdilac

zh.description: 执刑官混沌蛇主的刺骨长鞭。其独特的战术组合每次抽击时都会掀起巨大的能量波。
zh.name: 蝰首骨妖

en.description: Obtain enlightenment with this massive hammer that performs a Codex scan on each fatal strike. Scans require an equipped Codex Scanner and an available charge.
en.name: Heliocor

zh.description: 用这把重型战锤获得启示，它可以在每次毁灭性的攻击时进行资料库扫描。扫描需要携带一个资料库扫描器且有可用的扫描次数。
zh.name: 赫利俄光锤

en.description: Creates miniature gravitational singularities that can be used for scientific study or self-defense.
en.name: Simulor

zh.description: 能制造出微型的重力奇异点，可用于科学研究或自我防卫。
zh.name: 重力奇点拟成枪

en.description: The Acrid fires an acidic-infused needle.
en.name: Acrid

zh.description: 阿克里德可以射出注满强酸的刺针。
zh.name: 阿克里德

en.description: Torid lobs a toxic payload.
en.name: Torid

zh.description: 托里德能抛射出剧毒榴弹。
zh.name: 托里德

en.description: Ignis produces a stream of intense heat.
en.name: Ignis

zh.description: 伊格尼斯能产生一股强烈的热浪。
zh.name: 伊格尼斯

en.description: A blood-red variant of this destructive flamethrower.
en.name: Ignis Wraith

zh.description: 这款破坏性火焰喷射器的血红变体。
zh.name: 红莲伊格尼斯

en.description: Ogris fires detonite-infused casings.
en.name: Ogris

zh.description: 食人女魔能发射满载易爆物的炮弹。
zh.name: 食人女魔

en.description: The SUPRA is a heavy laser gun with a short wind up time.
en.name: Supra

zh.description: 苏普拉是把重型激光枪，可在很短的时间内启动。
zh.name: 苏普拉

en.description: While its intended design is for deep space construction, the concentrated laser beam of the Spectra is highly effective against organic and synthetic enemies.
en.name: Spectra

zh.description: 虽然它原本设计给太空中的工程师，光谱切割器的集中激光对有机和合成敌人也非常有效。
zh.name: 光谱切割器

en.description: Laser Rifle with Corpus safe-guards removed.
en.name: Flux Rifle

zh.description: 一把已卸除了科普斯安全装置的激光步枪。
zh.name: 通量步枪

en.description: A customized version of the Dera, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.
en.name: Dera Vandal

zh.description: 这把是定制化版本的德拉步枪，拥有着金属质感及莲的徽记。
zh.name: 德拉·破坏者

en.description: The Prova is a Melee Weapon that delivers a high-intensity shock to its target.
en.name: Prova

zh.description: 普罗沃是一把能对目标造成强大电击伤害的近战武器。
zh.name: 普罗沃

en.description: The Dera is a repeater that fires super-heated plasma.
en.name: Dera

zh.description: 德拉是一把射出高热电浆的连发步枪。
zh.name: 德拉

en.description: The Lanka fires a high velocity projectile through magnetic induction.
en.name: Lanka

zh.description: 兰卡使用电磁加速射出高速子弹。
zh.name: 兰卡

en.description: A customized version of the vicious Prova, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.
en.name: Prova Vandal

zh.description: 这是凶恶的普罗沃的定制化版本，拥有金属质感及莲花徽记。
zh.name: 普罗沃·破坏者

en.description: Custom variant of a Corpus classic. Staggering blasts now ricochet and have greater range at the cost of a slower fire and reload speed. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.
en.name: Tenet Arca Plasmor

zh.description: 科普斯经典武器的特制变体。惊人的爆炸会反弹且拥有更高的射程，但代价是更低的射速和装填速度。幸存下来的敌人会被辐射耗尽生命。
zh.name: 信条·弧电离子枪

en.description: The expert engineers in Parvos Granum’s division have optimized the Ferrox’s lethal power.
en.name: Tenet Ferrox

zh.description: 帕尔沃斯·格拉努部门的专业工程师优化了铁晶磁轨炮的杀伤力。
zh.name: 信条·铁晶磁轨炮

en.description: Sister-modified Flux Rifle with increased fire rate and range. Recharge has been replaced with ammo clips to accommodate greater power needs.
en.name: Tenet Flux Rifle

zh.description: 由姐妹们改装过的通量步枪提升了射速和射程。充电系统已被弹匣取代以适应更高的电量消耗。
zh.name: 信条·通量步枪

en.description: Advances in microelectronics have improved a Corpus classic. Tenet Glaxion’s photon beam strikes up to four enemies at once. It also boasts superior Damage, Critical Chance, and Status Chance.
en.name: Tenet Glaxion

zh.description: 微电子技术的进步改进了科普斯的经典武器。信条·冷冻光束步枪的光子束最多可以同时攻击四个敌人。它还拥有较高的伤害、暴击几率和触发几率。
zh.name: 信条·冷冻光束步枪

en.description: Once a mining tool adapted for military purposes, Parvosian engineering has enhanced the Quanta's lethality even further.
en.name: Tenet Quanta

zh.description: 曾经的采矿工具为了军事用途而改造，帕尔沃斯式的工程技术进一步增强了量子切割器的杀伤力。
zh.name: 信条·量子切割器

en.description: Parvosian upgrade of the classic Tetra. Slower fire rate but with a larger magazine. Can now alt-fire entire clip as a large burst radius grenade launcher.
en.name: Tenet Tetra

zh.description: 经典特拉的帕尔沃斯式升级版。射速较慢但拥有更大的弹匣。次要射击可以将整个弹匣作为高爆炸范围的榴弹发射出去。
zh.name: 信条·特拉

en.description: This reengineered Cycron features a refracting energy disc that can split off the main target, hitting up to 2 additional nearby targets.
en.name: Tenet Cycron

zh.description: 这款重新设计的循环离子枪拥有一个折射能量盘，光束射击可以从主要目标上分离，最多击中附近的两个额外目标。
zh.name: 信条·循环离子枪

en.description: Parvos Granum's engineers have made this already ferocious hand cannon even more deadly with the addition of an alternate fire mode that empties an entire clip in one devastating burst.
en.name: Tenet Detron

zh.description: 帕尔沃斯·格拉努的工程师们为这把已经十分凶猛的手炮增加了一种新的射击模式，在一次毁灭性的爆发中清空整个弹匣，使这把武器更加致命。
zh.name: 信条·德特昂

en.description: Alternate fire on this reengineered Plinx fires a projectile that pulls enemies close and then explodes. Its cooldown increases after the explosion to accommodate battery power demands.
en.name: Tenet Plinx

zh.description: 这把重新设计的漫射者可以使用次要射击模式发射一枚投射物将敌人拉近然后爆炸。爆炸后冷却时间会增加以满足电池的电量需求。
zh.name: 信条·漫射者

en.description:
Bolts from this Corpus bow deliver a one-two punch of an icy pulse, followed by a conventional explosion. Excess ammo picked up for other weapons will be converted into charges for the Lenz. 

Warning: Safety-protocols do not exist on this prototype.
en.name: Lenz

zh.description:
从这把科普斯弓箭中射出的箭矢将会放出极寒脉冲，紧接产生常规爆炸。额外拾取的其他武器弹药将会转化为楞次弓的电荷。

警告：此原型机未使用安全协议。
zh.name: 楞次弓

en.description: The explosive potential of the Lenz, enhanced with Prisma crystals.
en.name: Prisma Lenz

zh.description: 通过棱晶强化，楞次弓的爆炸潜力得以发掘。
zh.name: 棱晶·楞次弓

en.description: The Amprex rifle fires a continuous beam of high voltage electricity that arcs among nearby enemies. This weapon excels at Crowd Control.
en.name: Amprex

zh.description: 安培克斯步枪可持续发射致命电光束并在敌人中形成电弧。这件武器在群体控制方面很优秀。
zh.name: 安培克斯

en.description: Drawing from its huge quad-chambered magazine, the Tetra is capable of unleashing a sustained barrage of lethal energy bolts.
en.name: Tetra

zh.description: 借由它巨大的四腔弹匣，特拉能持续发射由能量弹形成的致命弹幕。
zh.name: 特拉

en.description: When bathed in Void energy and prisma crystal, the simple Tetra becomes a beacon of style and intimidation.
en.name: Prisma Tetra

zh.description: 在浸泡过虚空能量与棱晶后，这把单纯的特拉能量步枪成为了威吓与风格的指标。
zh.name: 棱晶·特拉

en.description: Bring negotiations to an instant conclusion with this Corpus assault rifle. Switch effortlessly between charged explosive shots and rapid-fire electrical assault mode.
en.name: Ambassador

zh.description: 使用这支科普斯突击步枪让谈判立即结束。可以在充能爆炸狙击和速射电子突击模式之间自由切换。
zh.name: 使节

en.description: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
en.name: Opticor Variant

zh.description: 一旦这挺科普斯激光炮充能完毕，便能释放出毁灭性的光能爆炸。
zh.name: 奥堤克光子枪变体

en.description: Once charged this Corpus laser cannon dispatches a devastating blast of light energy.
en.name: Opticor

zh.description: 一旦这挺科普斯激光炮充能完毕，便能释放出毁灭性的光能爆炸。
zh.name: 奥堤克光子枪

en.description: With a precision crafted lens, this customized Opticor achieves a level of performance previously thought impossible.
en.name: Opticor Vandal

zh.description: 装有精密制作的透镜，这把定制化版本的奥堤克光子枪达到了以前认为不可能有的性能水平。
zh.name: 奥堤克光子枪·破坏者

en.description: This discreet rocket launcher is equally at home in a board meeting or on a casual outing. Aimed rockets are wire-guided for greater accuracy, but travel more slowly. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the weapon when holstered.
en.name: Tenet Envoy

zh.description: 这款朴素的火箭发射器在董事会会议或休闲郊游时同样适用。瞄准发射的火箭是线导的，精确度更高，但飞行速度更慢。配备了获得专利批准的格拉努公文包系统，收起时自动装填。
zh.name: 信条·典客

en.description: Fires a photon beam that halts molecular vibrations, causing instant and painful freezing.
en.name: Glaxion

zh.description: 发射出一道能暂停分子振动的光子束，造成痛苦的瞬间冻结。
zh.name: 冷冻光束步枪

en.description: A cutting-edge, halogen-cooled electron accelerator capable of snap-freezing a target in moments.
en.name: Glaxion Vandal

zh.description: 一把用尖端技术打造的卤素冷却电子加速器，能够瞬间将目标冷冻起来。
zh.name: 冷冻光束步枪·破坏者

en.description: Nail them to the wall! The Stahlta automatic rifle propels hardened steel rods at high speed, while a charged fire mode fuses a number of volatile rods together for a large radioactive explosion.
en.name: Stahlta

zh.description: 将敌人钉在墙上！这件钢刃自动步枪把硬化钢棒推进到高速状态，而蓄力射击模式会将大量不稳定的钢棒融合在一起，产生巨大的放射性爆炸。
zh.name: 钢刃步枪

en.description: Corpus ingenuity leveraging Tau-tech to create a high-capacity bi-modal sniper weapon of terrifying capability. Zoom in to reduce recoil and add punch through. Zoom again to fire a bursting viral round, but with a lower rate of fire. Komorex features built-in ammo conversion.
en.name: Komorex

zh.description: 科普斯独具匠心地利用灵煞技术创造了一把可怕的大弹匣容量狙击枪。变焦可减少后坐力并增加穿透力。再次变焦可发射爆炸的病毒子弹，但射速降低。猛毒有自带的弹药转换。
zh.name: 猛毒

en.description: A weapon that builds charge the more it kills. Hit capacity then release for an obliterating discharge of power.
en.name: Battacor

zh.description: 一把借由消灭敌人来充能的武器。蓄满后可以释放出毁灭性的力量。
zh.name: 武使之力

en.description: Feel the kick of this Corpus shotgun as it shatters a high-yield crystal into anyone and anything standing in your way.
en.name: Exergis

zh.description: 当这把科普斯霰弹枪将高产水晶轰入阻挡在你前方的任何人或物时，请细细品味其后坐力。
zh.name: 晶能放射器

en.description: This weapon was designed to assist with the excavation of mineral deposits from large asteroids, but has been adapted for military purposes.
en.name: Quanta

zh.description: 这个武器原本是设计用来在大型小行星上协助挖掘矿物，但现在已更改为应用于军事用途上。
zh.name: 量子切割器

en.description: A customized version of the Quanta, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.
en.name: Quanta Vandal

zh.description: 这把是定制化版本的量子切割器，拥有着金属质感及莲的徽记。
zh.name: 量子切割器·破坏者

en.description: Stagger targets with blasts from this Corpus engineered plasma shotgun. Surviving enemies are consumed with radiation.
en.name: Arca Plasmor

zh.description: 用这把科普斯设计的等离子霰弹枪来击倒你的目标。幸存下来的敌人会被辐射耗尽生命。
zh.name: 弧电离子枪

en.description: When its twin-lasers converge on a target a circuit is created, frying the subject.
en.name: Convectrix

zh.description: 当双道激光汇聚在目标上时，便会产生回路，将敌人给炸熟。
zh.name: 导热聚焦枪

en.description: Enveloped in deep red composite enamel, this Penta variant features a higher fire-rate and over-sized magazine.
en.name: Carmine Penta

zh.description: 由深红色复合珐琅包络的潘塔变体，具有更高的射速和超大容量的弹匣。
zh.name: 嫣红·潘塔

en.description: The Penta Launcher fires up to five grenades that can be remotely triggered at just the right moment.
en.name: Penta

zh.description: 潘塔发射器最多可发射五发榴弹，并在最适当的时候进行远距离引爆。
zh.name: 潘塔

en.description: A customized version of the powerful Supra, featuring a metallic finish and Lotus decal.
en.name: Supra Vandal

zh.description: 强力苏普拉的定制版本，拥有着金属质感及莲的徽记。
zh.name: 苏普拉·破坏者

en.description: Discharge a rail of ionized death or throw the Ferrox like a spear and create a localized field of attraction no enemy can escape from.
en.name: Ferrox

zh.description: 释放一道电离的死光，或掷出铁晶磁轨炮以产生一个敌人无法逃脱的局部吸引力场。
zh.name: 铁晶磁轨炮

en.description: The sleek lines of the Granum Attaché case conceal an infinitely sharp two-handed blade. Blocked attacks have a chance to increase the blocking angle. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.
en.name: Tenet Livia

zh.description: 格拉努公文包的流畅线条下隐藏着削铁如泥的双持利刃。格挡攻击有几率增加格挡角度。配备了获得专利批准的格拉努公文包系统，收起时暂停连击倒计时。
zh.name: 信条·莉薇娅

en.description: On Heavy Slide Attack, this Corpus scythe launches a spinning energy disk that ricochets throughout the battlefield. Its lifetime is derived from the size of the Combo Counter. Note: The Granum Attaché system pauses the combo timer when holstered.
en.name: Tenet Grigori

zh.description: 滑行重击时，这把科普斯镰刀会发射一个旋转的能量盘在战场上弹跳。能量盘的持续时间由近战连击数决定。注意：格拉努公文包系统会在武器收起时暂停连击倒计时。
zh.name: 信条·格里高利

en.description: Prisma crystals glisten in these electrified tonfas.
en.name: Prisma Ohma

zh.description: 棱晶在这对带电的拐刃上闪闪发光。
zh.name: 棱晶·欧玛

en.description: Bring the enemy to its knees with these twin electrified tonfas.
en.name: Ohma

zh.description: 用这对带电的双子拐刃使你的敌人跪地求饶。
zh.name: 欧玛

en.description: This unsophisticated Corpus survival tool does what it was designed for: hacking and splitting whatever it strikes.
en.name: Kreska

zh.description: 这把简易的科普斯生存工具履行了它的设计目标：砍杀和分裂任何攻击对象。
zh.name: 直镐

en.description: An obscure glaive weapon of Corpus provenance, intrinsically linked to Specter technology. The Xoris strikes rapidly and with great devastation. It is capable of chaining combos infinitely.
en.name: Xoris

zh.description: 一件来源于科普斯商会且鲜为人知的战刃武器，与魅影技术有内在联系。「驱魔之刃」可以迅速进行打击，并拥有显著的破坏力。此外它可以无限进行连击。
zh.name: 驱魔之刃

en.description: Carve through enemies with surgical precision using this Corpus-tech glaive.
en.name: Falcor

zh.description: 用这把科普斯科技的战刃以手术般的精确性剖开敌人。
zh.name: 猎鹰轮

en.description: A short-blade melee weapon with an ace up its sleeve. Send nearby enemies flying with a powerful short-range shockwave.
en.name: Stropha

zh.description: 一件暗藏玄机的短刃近战武器。通过强大的短程冲击波来击飞附近的敌人。
zh.name: 诡计之刃

en.description: Each successive kill from this massive electron hammer builds an electron charge that is unleashed on slam attacks.
en.name: Arca Titron

zh.description: 这柄巨型电子重锤的每一次连续消灭都会积累一重电荷，可以通过震地攻击将其释放出来。
zh.name: 弧电振子锤

en.description: The Obex system multiplies the kinetic energy of a Tenno's kicks and punches, delivering devastating blows to any target.
en.name: Obex

zh.description: 奥比克斯战斗系统能强化天诺战士的近身肉搏能力，给予目标致命伤害。
zh.name: 奥比克斯

en.description: Dazzle, distract and destroy with these sparring weapons of impossibly hard prisma crystal.
en.name: Prisma Obex

zh.description: 用这件由无比坚硬的棱晶所打造的搏击武器，打出令人眼花缭乱的招式，进而摧毁敌人。
zh.name: 棱晶·奥比克斯

en.description: Developed as an energy saw to scrap obsolete ships, this tool was quickly banned when rebels in the Sedna region discovered it also made an excellent weapon.
en.name: Serro

zh.description: 能源锯的开发目的原是用以报废淘汰船只，但在赛德娜地区的反抗份子发现它也能用来作为优良的武器使用时，它很快就被禁止使用。
zh.name: 电能斩锯

en.description: Drive the agenda with this massive impact hammer. Heavy attacks launch devastating energy disks.
en.name: Tenet Agendus

zh.description: 用这把重型冲击锤推动议程。重击会发射毁灭性的能量盘。
zh.name: 信条·集议

en.description: Half taser, half whip. The Corpus Lecta delivers a deadly shock to anything it touches.
en.name: Lecta

zh.description: 一半电击器一半鞭子。这条科普斯商会的勒克塔会对接触到的任何东西发出致命电击。
zh.name: 勒克塔

en.description: Shock and maim with this heavyweight retractable whip.
en.name: Galvacord

zh.description: 使用这把重型伸缩鞭施以电击与残害。
zh.name: 电流刺索

en.description: The sleek lines of the Detron conceal its ferocious nature. The hand cannon's semi-automatic action takes down enemies with speed and efficiency.
en.name: Detron

zh.description: 德特昂的流线型线条掩饰其凶残本性，这把半自动手枪是快速并有效率地击倒敌人。
zh.name: 德特昂

en.description: Compact and deadly, the Cestra discharges bolts of energy at an increasingly rapid rate.
en.name: Cestra

zh.description: 小巧而致命的锡斯特，以越来越快的射速释放能量弹。
zh.name: 锡斯特

en.description: Wield two Cestras to unleash a dual torrent of high energy bolts.
en.name: Dual Cestra

zh.description: 双手各持一把锡斯特释放出双流高能量弹幕。
zh.name: 锡斯特双枪

en.description: A special-order Corpus cutting tool for master crafters only. Features distinctive azurite plating and a focusing crystal of precision clarity and cut.
en.name: Spectra Vandal

zh.description: 一把特殊订制的科普斯切割工具，只适用于大师级工匠。具有独特的蓝铜色电镀外观和用于精准清澈化以及切割的聚焦水晶。
zh.name: 光谱切割器·破坏者

en.description: Blasts targets with a massive wave of sonic energy. Results reported to be: 'Very Satisfying'.
en.name: Sonicor

zh.description: 以巨大的声波能量震飞目标。使用报告的结果是：非常爽。
zh.name: 超音波冲击枪

en.description: Itemize and execute with this pair of auto-lock-on, homing-projectile pistols. Shoot from-hip for a more conventional pistol experience. The patented Granum Attaché System reloads the pistols when holstered.
en.name: Tenet Diplos

zh.description: 用这对自动锁定追踪目标的双枪将敌人逐个击破。腰射模式与传统手枪无异。配备了获得专利批准的格拉努公文包系统，收起时自动装填。
zh.name: 信条·纵横双枪

en.description: Forgo ammunition with the regenerating energy disc in this plasma throwing pistol.
en.name: Cycron

zh.description: 用这把装有能量恢复圆盘的等离子体发射手枪摆脱弹药的限制。
zh.name: 循环离子枪

en.description: Send a massive charge of potential energy hurling toward unfortunate targets.
en.name: Staticor

zh.description: 将强大的静电势能射向不幸的敌人。
zh.name: 静电能量导引枪

en.description: Capable of firing multiple rockets at once, the Angstrum is a handheld instrument of destruction.
en.name: Angstrum

zh.description: 能够同时发射若干火箭的安格斯壮是一个手持的毁灭工具。
zh.name: 安格斯壮

en.description: Imbued with the finest Prisma crystal, this refined Angstrum features boosted charge and reload speeds.
en.name: Prisma Angstrum

zh.description: 灌注了最出色的棱晶，这款经过精制后的安格斯壮的特点是具有更快的蓄力和装填速度。
zh.name: 棱晶·安格斯壮

en.description: Dominate rivals with this pistol’s lightning fast rail-slugs. Head-shots speed up reload.
en.name: Tenet Spirex

zh.description: 用这把手枪快如闪电的弹道压制对手。爆头可加快装填速度。
zh.name: 信条·斯派克斯

en.description: Sentient tech merges with Corpus design to deliver this lethal sidearm. Fully automatic, it fires ricocheting, homing projectiles that release small clouds of <DT_GAS_COLOR>Gas on impact. Alt-fire to release the entire magazine without homing as a single burst.
en.name: Cyanex

zh.description: 灵煞科技与科普斯设计的结合，发展出这款致命的副武器。该武器为全自动，可射出跳飞式、自动导引的弹幕，子弹在撞击时会释放出小一股 <DT_GAS_COLOR>毒气。次要射击模式为可在单次射击中释放剩余的弹药。
zh.name: 氰毒

en.description: A weapon that reaches for its next victim even as it kills. With each takedown, this pistol spawns an energy tendril that reaches for a nearby target.
en.name: Ocucor

zh.description: 在消灭同时便已准备好对下一名受害者伸出魔爪的一种武器。每次消灭，这把手枪会生成能量卷须伸向邻近目标。
zh.name: 视使之触

en.description: Cultivate a meaningful relationship with this deceptively simple battery-powered pistol. The Plinx rewards attention and investment from the wise.
en.name: Plinx

zh.description: 与这把看似朴素的电池手枪培养出深厚的情感。漫射者最能回馈来自智者的关注与投资。
zh.name: 漫射者

en.description: This scoped pistol analyzes strikes, learning how to damage its targets most effectively. Achieve maximum damage output after five successive hits.
en.name: Arca Scisco

zh.description: 这把带有瞄准镜的手枪会分析着弹，获悉如何更有效的对目标造成伤害。在连续成功命中五次后会达到最大的伤害输出。
zh.name: 弧电探知者

en.description: An unused, unfused artifact.
en.name: Unfused Artifact

zh.description: 一个未经使用，未融合过的神器。
zh.name: 未融合过的神器

en.name: Unfused Artifact

zh.name: 未融合过的神器

en.name: Unfused Artifact
