en.description: Dating back to the time of the first Tenno, the Glaive is a uniquely deadly weapon. This multi-bladed disc is not only effective for melee combat; it can also be thrown like a boomerang to cut down enemies at a distance.
en.name: Glaive

zh.description: 在第一个天诺战士的时代，战刃是一件奇怪而强大的武器。这多刀刃圆盘不单可用于近身战，更可如回力镖般使用，在一定距离外把敌人一分为二。
zh.name: 战刃

en.description: Dating back to the time of the first Tenno, the Glaive is a uniquely deadly weapon. This multi-bladed disc is not only effective for melee combat; it can also be thrown like a boomerang to cut down enemies at a distance.
en.name: Glaive Variant

zh.description: 在第一个天诺战士的时代，战刃是一件奇怪而强大的武器。这多刀刃圆盘不单可用于近身战，更可如回力镖般使用，在一定距离外把敌人一分为二。
zh.name: 战刃变体

en.description: The Glaive Prime is a deadly and beautiful weapon from the Orokin era. The blades are as effective in close quarters as they are when thrown at distant enemies.
en.name: Glaive Prime

zh.description: 圣装战刃在奥罗金时代是一把致命和优美的武器，其刀刃在近距离战斗时也与对远距离敌人掷出时一样有效。
zh.name: 圣装战刃

en.description: With heightened agility and power the Kestrel Prime's heavy attacks easily knock down foes, ensuring none shall stand before it.
en.name: Kestrel Prime

zh.description: 凭借更高的敏捷性和力量，圣装红隼的重击可以轻松击倒敌人，所向披靡。
zh.name: 圣装红隼

en.description: Turn foes into puppets with Teshin’s versatile throwing disc.
en.name: Orvius

zh.description: 使用泰辛灵活多变的飞盘将敌人变成你的提线木偶。
zh.name: 灵枢

en.description: The heavy two-handed sword known as Gram requires great strength to wield, but it is notorious for its splitting power. Can hit multiple targets with each strike.
en.name: Gram

zh.description: 这把名为格拉姆的大剑以其强大的斩击力令人闻风丧胆，需要巨力才可挥舞自如。其攻击可以击中多名敌人。
zh.name: 格拉姆

en.description: Makes sweeping cuts punctuated by bursts of heavy gunfire.
en.name: Sarpa

zh.description: 在连续切砍之间夹杂重火力连发。
zh.name: 蛇刃

en.description: Deal double-bladed, double-barreled death with this primed gunblade.
en.name: Redeemer Prime

zh.description: 以这把圣装枪刃制造出双重刀刃、双重口径伤口的死亡。
zh.name: 圣装救赎者

en.description: Striking with massive twin blades, the Redeemer fires the killing blow with its built-in shotgun.
en.name: Redeemer

zh.description: 救赎者能以巨大的双刃进行攻击，并用内建的霰弹枪造成致命一击。
zh.name: 救赎者

en.description: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Power Strike slams Sampotes into the ground to damage enemies with a shockwave that inflicts <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat Status.
en.name: Sampotes

zh.description: 喜欢蛮力的战士会充分利用三宝聚。使用强力攻击猛击地面，用产生的冲击波伤害敌人，并造成 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰异常状态。
zh.name: 三宝聚

en.description: A warrior who prefers brute force will make the most of Sampotes. Its Slams and Heavy Slams have an extended area of effect.
en.name: Sampotes

zh.description: 喜欢蛮力的战士会充分利用三宝聚，它的震地攻击和重型震地攻击具有更广的影响范围。
zh.name: 三宝聚

en.description: Tear and maim with this agile, lightweight glass hammer. When Gara's wields her signature melee weapon, it gains additional Slam Radial Damage.
en.name: Volnus

zh.description: 用这把轻量灵活的玻璃锤来撕裂并残害目标。琉璃仕女的标志性近战武器。在被琉璃仕女使用时，它会获得额外的震地范围伤害。
zh.name: 创伤

en.description: A large two-handed hammer, the Fragor requires great strength to wield, but impacts with enough force to send groups of enemies tumbling.
en.name: Fragor

zh.description: 巨大的双手锤，重击巨锤拥有能将复数敌人击飞的力量。
zh.name: 重击巨锤

en.description: Ice in motion can crush mountains, this frozen hammer is no different.
en.name: Sibear

zh.description: 冰移可以碾碎山峰，这把冰锤的效果也是一样。
zh.name: 西伯利亚冰锤

en.description: The signature weapon of the only lunatic fearsome enough to bust out of the Saturn Six Max-Pen. Once loosed this formidable throwing hammer always finds its way home.
en.name: Wolf Sledge

zh.description: 能逃脱出土星六号最高戒备监狱的唯一可怕狂人的标志性武器。一旦被解放，这把强大的战锤总是能找到回家的路。
zh.name: 恶狼战锤

en.description: This Heavy Scythe echoes battles of another time. It is far more a weapon of sheer force than one of finesse.
en.name: Hespar

zh.description: 这把重型镰刀呼应了另一个时代的战斗。其更像是一种纯粹的力量型武器，而不是一种技巧型武器。
zh.name: 暮斩

en.description: The wrath of one who knows revenge is all about timing. Orion's signature Heavy Scythe.
en.name: Wrath

zh.description: 复仇之道，重在时机，此为深谙此语之人的怒火。奥里昂的标志性重型镰刀。
zh.name: 愤怒

en.description: The pride of one that knows their worth. Sirius' signature Heavy Scythe.
en.name: Pride

zh.description: 知晓自身价值的人，自有傲骨。西里斯的标志性重型镰刀。
zh.name: 骄傲

en.description: A single blade for more precision. The Ether Sword cuts so cleanly that it was considered by the Tenno to be a more humane weapon for ‘cleansing' infested allies.
en.name: Ether Sword

zh.description: 苍穹之剑的斩切非常锐利，是一把精准的刀刃，被认为是天诺用来清除受感染伙伴的慈悲武器。
zh.name: 苍穹之剑

en.description: Before all other weapons, Tenno master the Skana. This simple blade becomes immensely powerful in the hands of a master. For Tenno, it is the foundation of their fighting style and a pillar of their culture.
en.name: Skana

zh.description: 天诺战士在各种武器之中，最先精通的是空刃。其朴素的刀刃在他们手中是无比的强大。对天诺战士来说，这是他们战斗的基础以及文化的支柱。
zh.name: 空刃

en.description: A basic blade known as a Skana. It is widely used by the Tenno. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.
en.name: Skana Prime

zh.description: 一副被称为空刃的基础刀刃，受到天诺战士广泛的使用。圣装版本提供了更高一些的伤害。
zh.name: 圣装空刃

en.description: The Magistar mace wields justice and truth in the form of bone-crushing blows.
en.name: Magistar

zh.description: 执法者钉锤以碎骨般的打击来执掌正义与真理。
zh.name: 执法者

en.description: Downward cuts with an impact combo.
en.name: Rending Crane

zh.description: 下砍附带冲击的连段。
zh.name: 撕裂鹤击

en.description: Sweeping strikes and twisting slashes.
en.name: Tempo Royale

zh.description: 扫荡般的挥击与曲斜的斩击。
zh.name: 皇家节奏

en.description: Arcing cuts with spinning finish.
en.name: Cleaving Whirlwind

zh.description: 弧切与回旋斩。
zh.name: 弧刃回天

en.description: Relentless jabs and powerful sweeping lunges.
en.name: Harrowing Spire

zh.description: 持续不断的戳刺和强劲有力的横扫式冲刺。
zh.name: 胆寒尖刺

en.description: Puncturing strikes and quick slashes.
en.name: Malicious Raptor

zh.description: 穿刺攻击和快速的切割。
zh.name: 恶毒猛禽

en.description: Fast strikes, powerful slams.
en.name: Four Riders

zh.description: 快速的打击与强烈猛击。
zh.name: 天启异象

en.description: Kicks woven between spinning slashes.
en.name: Vermillion Storm

zh.description: 在旋转的切斩之中组合了踢击。
zh.name: 朱红暴风

en.description: Strong whirlwind attacks.
en.name: Crimson Dervish

zh.description: 有如旋风般的强烈攻击。
zh.name: 赤红狂舞

en.description: Fast strikes, many hits.
en.name: Homing Fang

zh.description: 命中多次的快速打击。
zh.name: 连牙追袭

en.description: Vigorous slashes with forceful stabs.
en.name: Stinging Thorn

zh.description: 带有强力刺击的凶猛挥砍
zh.name: 螫刺狂棘

en.description: Spiral strikes, lifting combos.
en.name: Pointed Wind

zh.description: 旋转打击，不断上升的连段。
zh.name: 尖锐之风

en.description: Strong, focused attacks with multi-hit spins.
en.name: Sinking Talon

zh.description: 强劲，多段命中的旋转集中攻击。
zh.name: 沉没之爪

en.description: Swift stabs, twisting slashes.
en.name: Spinning Needle

zh.description: 迅速刺击，扭转切割
zh.name: 旋压刺针

en.description: Lunging punctures with impaling spirals.
en.name: Gnashing Payara

zh.description: 以贯通螺旋刺穿。
zh.name: 狼鱼咬咬

en.description: Sharp movements with wide reach.
en.name: Mountain's Edge

zh.description: 动作迅猛、打击面广。
zh.name: 山之锋芒

en.description: Fanning, multi-hit strikes.
en.name: Swirling Tiger

zh.description: 扇动，多段命中的攻击。
zh.name: 旋风虎击

en.description: Strong slashes and quick stabs that keeps momentum forward.
en.name: Carving Mantis

zh.description: 强力的斩击和快速的戳刺，保持向前的动量。
zh.name: 雕斩螳螂

en.description: Multi-angle strikes and deadly thrust attacks.
en.name: Crossing Snakes

zh.description: 多重角度攻击和致命刺击。
zh.name: 双蛇牙突

en.description: Fast, multi-hit strikes with powerful finishers.
en.name: Fracturing Wind

zh.description: 快速，多次命中的打击与强力的处决攻击。
zh.name: 破碎之风

en.description: Slow, powerful strikes.
en.name: Gaia's Tragedy

zh.description: 缓慢而沉重的打击
zh.name: 母神悲歌

en.description: Methodical strikes with reaching combos.
en.name: Seismic Palm

zh.description: 有条不紊的近距离组合攻击。
zh.name: 震撼冲拳

en.description: Fast arcing strikes.
en.name: Gleaming Talon

zh.description: 快速的飞弧攻击。
zh.name: 微光利爪

en.description: Orbiting slashes and lashing strikes.
en.name: Astral Twilight

zh.description: 周身环绕的切斩与甩击。
zh.name: 星界微光

en.description: Bullets spray between wicked slash attacks.
en.name: High Noon

zh.description: 在连续的凶狠斩击之间开火射击
zh.name: 正午

en.description: Sharpened blades dance with gunfire.
en.name: Bullet Dance

zh.description: 枪火与刀锋交织的华丽漫舞。
zh.name: 刀锋弹舞

en.description: Methodical strikes and high impact combos.
en.name: Shattering Storm

zh.description: 流畅打击和高冲击的连段。
zh.name: 云暴山碎

en.description: Aerial attacks with Crowd Control combos.
en.name: Crushing Ruin

zh.description: 空中攻击具备群体控制的攻击连段。
zh.name: 月落乌啼

en.description: Wide slashes and heavy strikes.
en.name: Galeforce Dawn

zh.description: 横扫切割与重型打击。
zh.name: 狂风压境

en.description: Fast cutting attacks with puncture finish.
en.name: Iron Phoenix

zh.description: 快速切割攻击用穿刺完结。
zh.name: 钢铁凤凰

en.description: Powerful arcs with frenzied combo.
en.name: Tranquil Cleave

zh.description: 强力弧斩附带疯狂的连段。
zh.name: 秋风落叶

en.description: Reverse grip style emphasizing slashing and impaling strikes.
en.name: Blind Justice

zh.description: 反握的持刀风格，强调其猛烈的斩击以及刺击。
zh.name: 无明制裁

en.description: Fierce, double-handed strikes.
en.name: Decisive Judgement

zh.description: 凶猛的双持打击。
zh.name: 果断裁决

en.description: Deftly executed sweeps and slashes.
en.name: Wise Razor

zh.description: 灵巧般完成扫荡和斩击
zh.name: 慧黠斩剃

en.description: Steady chopping strikes with focused damage.
en.name: Sundering Weave

zh.description: 造成集中伤害的沉稳切击。
zh.name: 分裂编织

en.description: Brutal strikes with deft movement.
en.name: Cyclone Kraken

zh.description: 带有灵巧移动的残暴攻击。
zh.name: 飓风海怪

en.description: Rapid strikes, deceptive movements.
en.name: Atlantis Vulcan

zh.description: 虚实难辨、动作快速的打击。
zh.name: 深渊之火

en.description: Fast spinning attacks and staggering strikes.
en.name: Shimmering Blight

zh.description: 快速旋转攻击和惊人的突击。
zh.name: 飞光荒疫

en.description: A mix of sweeping attacks with precise strikes.
en.name: Twirling Spire

zh.description: 大范围的扫打与精准打击的混合。
zh.name: 回转尖峰

en.description: A blend of strong and rapid strikes with leaping combos.
en.name: Bleeding Willow

zh.description: 强大的和快速攻击与跳跃组合。
zh.name: 血色万柳

en.description: Lightning fast hit chains and hard-hitting combos.
en.name: Grim Fury

zh.description: 闪电般迅速的连击和重击组合。
zh.name: 冷面狂怒

en.description: Round-house attacks and leaping fists.
en.name: Brutal Tide

zh.description: 回旋踢和飞越拳击。
zh.name: 残暴浪潮

en.description: Swift cuts, lancing strikes.
en.name: Vulpine Mask

zh.description: 快速切割，刺穿攻击
zh.name: 狡狐诈面

en.description: Fast strikes, many hits.
en.name: Homing Fang

zh.description: 命中多次的快速打击。
zh.name: 连牙追袭

en.description: Powerful slashes and shield attacks.
en.name: Final Harbinger

zh.description: 强力的斩切与盾牌攻击。
zh.name: 最终先驱

en.description: Rip and rend with this Assault Saw stance.
en.name: Butcher's Revelry

zh.description: 采用这种突击锯架势来撕裂并锯碎你的敌人。
zh.name: 屠戮盛宴

en.description: Far flung attacks and multi-hit combos.
en.name: Reaping Spiral

zh.description: 大范围的挥动攻击与多次命中的连段。
zh.name: 收割螺旋

en.description: Lunging spirals and shattering combos.
en.name: Stalking Fan

zh.description: 毁灭性的冲刺螺旋连段。
zh.name: 缠旋风切

en.description: Arcing strikes and focused combos.
en.name: Clashing Forest

zh.description: 弧线攻击与集中的连段
zh.name: 巨林冲击

en.description: Lifting strikes and whirlwind combos.
en.name: Flailing Branch

zh.description: 上升打击和旋风的连段。
zh.name: 多流抽击

en.description: Hate... Dread... Despair...
en.name: Vengeful Revenant

zh.description: 憎恨……恐惧……绝望……
zh.name: 复仇亡灵

en.description: Quick slashes with spinning lunges.
en.name: Swooping Falcon

zh.description: 旋转突刺中的快速斩击。
zh.name: 猎鹰俯击

en.description: Rapid attacks using sword and shield.
en.name: Eleventh Storm

zh.description: 使用剑和盾的快速攻击。
zh.name: 终焉风暴

en.description: Sudden lashes, lethal slashes.
en.name: Defiled Snapdragon

zh.description: 迅如闪电的鞭笞，致命般的砍击。
zh.name: 积秽骁龙

en.description: A style exhibiting sweeping slash attacks and swift jabs.
en.name: Gemini Cross

zh.description: 一种扫荡般的切斩以及戳刺攻击方式。
zh.name: 纵横双子

en.description: An outlandish style with sweeping attacks.
en.name: Sovereign Outcast

zh.description: 有着连绵不绝攻击手段的诡异风格。
zh.name: 至尊浪人

en.description: Twirling, acrobatic slashes with a refined touch.
en.name: Slicing Feathers

zh.description: 旋转、杂技般的挥砍，配合着精妙的点睛招式。
zh.name: 割裂羽翼

en.description: Precise, focused arcs and cuts not hampered by pity.
en.name: Votive Onslaught

zh.description: 精确、集中的弧切，不带一丝怜悯。
zh.name: 埋首猛击

en.description: Chaining combos.
en.name: Burning Wasp

zh.description: 施展连环鞭击。
zh.name: 炙热黄蜂

en.description: Powerful arcing strikes with energetic flips.
en.name: Coiling Viper

zh.description: 带着强力翻转的弧状攻击。
zh.name: 毒蛇螺旋

en.description: With its lightning-fast strikes, the Ninkondi pays respect to the old ways.
en.name: Ninkondi

zh.description: 这把降灵追猎者凭借其迅如闪电的打击，充分体现了古老的战斗形式。
zh.name: 降灵追猎者

en.description: With these blazing fast nunchaku, the enemy will never know what hit them.
en.name: Shaku

zh.description: 这副双节棍挥动速度极快，敌人永远不会知道是被什么武器给击中。
zh.name: 双节尺棍

en.description: Each kill with this swooping blade adds bonus damage to the Djinn Sentinel’s next Fatal Attraction ability. In turn, Fatal Attraction bestows the weapon with a period of <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>Corrosive Damage.
en.name: Gazal Machete

zh.description: 每次用这把俯冲样式的刀刃击杀会给引灵下一次释放的致命诱惑增加额外的伤害。作为回报，致命诱惑会赋予这把武器一段时间的 <DT_CORROSIVE_COLOR>腐蚀伤害。
zh.name: 加扎勒反曲刀

en.description: Edun befits dexterous warriors. Power Strike knocks down and blinds enemies by surrounding them with a cloud of dust.
en.name: Edun

zh.description: 雷石祭适合于机敏的战士。使用强力攻击激起一团环绕敌人的尘雾，从而击倒并致盲他们。
zh.name: 雷石祭

en.description: Edun befits a dextrous warrior. Heavy Attack to throw Edun. Edun explodes after it is embedded in an enemy.
en.name: Edun

zh.description: 雷石祭适合于机敏的战士。重击以投掷出雷石祭。 雷石祭在刺入敌人体内后便会爆炸。
zh.name: 雷石祭

en.description: During the darkest days of the Old War many a Tenno relied solely on the Tonbo to keep them alive.
en.name: Tonbo

zh.description: 在远古之战中最黑暗的那几天中，许多天诺战士仅能靠着蜻蛉薙生还下来。
zh.name: 蜻蛉薙

en.description: When Combo Multiplier reaches 8x, Heavy attacks apply a random Status Effect to enemies hit.
en.name: Amanata Pressure

zh.description: 当连击倍率达到 8 倍时，重击会对被击中的敌人造成随机异常状态。
zh.name: 天薙刀 压迫点

en.description: Roll Koumei's die with every 30 hits from Amanata to empower yourself with 1 of 5 Koumei blessings. Roll a 6 to receive all blessings at once.
en.name: Amanata

zh.description: 天薙刀每命中敌人 30 次，就掷一次御命织姬的骰子。掷出 1 到 5 的结果各赋予一种增益，而掷出 6 则一次性赋予所有增益。
zh.name: 天薙刀

en.description: The Tenno forged Orthos is a rare double bladed polearm. Those who take the time to master it speak of its impressive striking distance and ability to hit multiple targets.
en.name: Orthos

zh.description: 由天诺战士所铸造的欧特鲁斯是把罕见的双刃长矛。对于投入时间掌握这把武器的人们总会谈起它令人印象深刻的攻击距离与群击能力。
zh.name: 欧特鲁斯

en.description: That a god might reap a harvest of lives.
en.name: Guandao Prime

zh.description: 收割生命之神。
zh.name: 圣装关刀

en.description: Orthos Prime is an ancient Orokin martial weapon, forged from the purest Rubedo making it extremely light-weight.
en.name: Orthos Prime

zh.description: 作为上古奥罗金的军用武器，圣装欧特鲁斯由最纯净的红化结晶制成，因而极其轻盈。
zh.name: 圣装欧特鲁斯

en.description: Harvest the enemy with this towering polearm.
en.name: Guandao

zh.description: 用这把如塔般耸立的长柄武器收割敌人。
zh.name: 关刀

en.description: Light and nimble, the twin blades of this polearm will swoop and slice through throngs of hardened foes.
en.name: Cassowar

zh.description: 轻盈且灵巧。即使是防护严密的成群敌人，也会被这件长柄武器上的双刃所肢解。
zh.name: 鹤鸵长戟

en.description: The sensual lines of these golden Kamas have long been celebrated as a masterwork of Tenno weapon smithing.
en.name: Dual Kamas Prime

zh.description: 这对拥有迷人线条的金色短柄战镰，长久以来一直被奉为天诺武器锻造的杰作。
zh.name: 圣装双短柄战镰

en.description: A beautifully forged instrument of devastation.
en.name: Fragor Prime

zh.description: 一把为了摧毁一切而锻造的终极兵器。
zh.name: 圣装重击巨锤

en.description: Deliver a golden knockout with these prime Melee Weapons.
en.name: Kogake Prime

zh.description: 用这副圣装近战武器打出金色的击倒。
zh.name: 圣装科加基

en.description: An ancient weapon imbued with a new truth.
en.name: Ninkondi Prime

zh.description: 一把注入了新真理的古老武器。
zh.name: 圣装降灵追猎者

en.description: A perfectly crafted pairing, this mace and shield combination is sculpted for exhibition but balanced for the battlefield.
en.name: Silva & Aegis Prime

zh.description: 完美打造的一对，权杖与盾的组合不仅是为了展示而雕凿，也权衡了战场的用途。
zh.name: 圣装席瓦 & 神盾

en.description: As merciless and indestructible as Atlas Prime himself, Tekko Prime crush and split with tectonic force.
en.name: Tekko Prime

zh.description: 如圣装撼天刑者自身一样无情且坚不可摧，圣装铁钩手甲通过地动之力粉碎并撕裂敌人。
zh.name: 圣装铁钩手甲

en.description: Gleaming blades of white draw blood of the deepest red.
en.name: Venka Prime

zh.description: 拥有剃刀般切开敌人的锐利爪子。
zh.name: 圣装凯旋之爪

en.description: The glorious original Orokin casting of Gara’s signature glass hammer. Deceptively light and swift, while remaining lethally effective.
en.name: Volnus Prime

zh.description: 作为最初由奥罗金所铸造的辉煌，琉璃仕女标志性的玻璃锤看似轻敏，却极具杀伤力。
zh.name: 圣装创伤

en.description: With a blade forged from the same material as the Ether Sword, the Ether Reaper delivers quick death to its victims.
en.name: Ether Reaper

zh.description: 采用与苍穹之剑相同材质来锻造刀身，让苍穹镰刀迅速的为受害者献上死亡。
zh.name: 苍穹死神

en.description: Reap havoc with this full sized Tenno-crafted scythe.
en.name: Anku

zh.description: 带来毁灭与收割生命的制式规格镰刀，由天诺战士所锻造。
zh.name: 夺魂死神

en.description: Reap havoc with this full sized Tenno-crafted scythe.
en.name: Solstice Scythe

zh.description: 带来毁灭与收割生命的制式规格镰刀，由天诺战士所锻造。
zh.name: 冬至镰刀

en.description: Fashioned from the willingly donated bone of the Sentient Ur-Hatho and embellished by Orokin luxurator Sembik Vol, Venato Prime was to be wielded against "common enemies" of the united peoples – had any ever emerged from the darkness beyond Tau.
en.name: Venato Prime

zh.description: 由灵煞 Ur-Hatho 自愿捐献的骨骼打造，并由奥罗金奢华工匠森比克·沃尔精心装饰，圣装脉纹本应被用于对抗联盟的"共同敌人"——任何从陶之外的黑暗中现身的人。
zh.name: 圣装脉纹

en.description: Reaper Prime is an ornamental scythe, with a blade forged from tempered Rubedo.
en.name: Reaper Prime

zh.description: 圣装收割者是一把装饰用镰刀，带有以回火工艺处理过的红化结晶锻造的刀刃。
zh.name: 圣装收割者

en.description: Hate is a scythe with a cruel blade, wielded by The Stalker.
en.name: Hate

zh.description: 追猎者持有憎恨，这是一把残忍至极的镰刀。
zh.name: 憎恨

en.description:
Harmony triumphs over hate. Heavy Attacks condense Status Effect damage into a single instance. Heavy Attack kills empower allies with increased Status Duration.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.
en.name: Harmony

zh.description:
和谐战胜憎恨。重击会立刻结算所有的异常状态效果伤害。使用重击消灭敌人可增强友军的触发时间。

当晚祷、歌颂与和谐一同奏响时，体验圣天使之合奏真正的力量。
zh.name: 和谐

en.description: Razor sharp battle-hatchets, designed to compliment the Soma.
en.name: Dual Raza

zh.description: 这组锐利战斧是为了配合月神而设计的。
zh.name: 锋月双斧

en.description: Fashioned with Grineer materials and balanced for marine infantry use, the Amphis is a traditional staff weapon that has received a monstrous makeover that enables shock damage on jump attacks. Connects with multiple enemies with each strike.
en.name: Amphis

zh.description: 以克隆尼材料制成，设计为海军陆战队使用，双头蛇是一把为了附带电击伤害而接受了大幅改造的传统棍棒武器——跳跃攻击附带电击伤害。可以同时打击多个敌人。
zh.name: 双头蛇

en.description: With its crescent shaped blades flying in sweeping arcs and striking at tremendous speed, the Tipedo demands focus from those wishing to unlock its true power.
en.name: Tipedo

zh.description: 带有新月型刀刃的提佩多，能以弧形横扫飞舞并以惊人的高速进行攻击。使用者若想释放提佩多的真正威力，必须高度集中精神。
zh.name: 提佩多

en.description: A classic Orokin weapon, Bo Prime creates elegant fury on the battlefield.
en.name: Bo Prime

zh.description: 经典的奥罗金武器圣装玻之武杖，以优雅的怒火横扫战场。
zh.name: 圣装玻之武杖

en.description: A lone Tenno once used this staff to fight back a horde of Infested.
en.name: Cadus

zh.description: 曾经有一名孤身一人的天诺战士以这柄单手杖击退了一整个群落的感染者。
zh.name: 卡德斯

en.description: A two-handed, reinforced staff that can send multiple enemies airborne.
en.name: Bo

zh.description: 双手强化长棍，它可以将敌人击飞。
zh.name: 玻之武杖

en.description: With their final breath they look to the moon, and are gone.
en.name: Tipedo Prime

zh.description: 随着凝望月亮时呼出的最后一口气，就这样永久的消散了。
zh.name: 圣装提佩多

en.description: Scorch enemies with blistering blows, or set them ablaze with the flying fire disc.
en.name: Zenistar

zh.description: 令敌人在炽烈的打击中焚灭，或用飞行的火盘将他们点燃。
zh.name: 天顶之星

en.description: Leverage bleeding-edge Granum tech with this massive heavy blade. Slam sends forth a cascading set of three shockwaves, while Heavy Slam unleashes a swath of shockwaves.
en.name: Tenet Exec

zh.description: 这把重型巨刃使用了最前沿的格拉努科技。震地攻击会向前发射三道冲击波，而重型震地攻击则会发射大量冲击波。
zh.name: 信条·枢密

en.description: Like the surge and crash of storm waves, a master of the Nami cutlass and Skyla dagger turns these two separate weapons into one fluid attack.
en.name: Nami Skyla

zh.description: 像暴风雨的汹涌和破坏力一样，精通海波斯库拉对剑的人可以使用这两把不同的武器完成流畅的进攻。
zh.name: 海波斯库拉对剑

en.description: Evoking the oceans of earth, this exquisite cutlass is a deadly work of art.
en.name: Nami Solo

zh.description: 唤起对地球上的海洋的记忆，这把精美的弯刀是一件致命的艺术品。
zh.name: 海波单剑

en.description: A blade forged using dark metals, capable of delivering innate <DT_RADIATION_COLOR>Radiation Damage with attacks.
en.name: Dark Sword

zh.description: 一把使用暗黑金属制作的长剑，每次攻击都会附带<DT_RADIATION_COLOR>辐射伤害。
zh.name: 暗黑长剑

en.description: Use as a devastating heavy sword or apply a Dual Melee stance and split the weapon into two ferocious blades.
en.name: Dark Split-Sword

zh.description: 能作为强大破坏力的重剑使用，或以近战双持架式将武器化为两把凶残的刀刃。
zh.name: 暗黑分合剑

en.description: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Power Strike lifts enemies into the air and unleashes a flurry of deadly slashes.
en.name: Syam

zh.description: 业珀在专注的战士手中物尽其用。使用强力攻击将敌人震飞至空中，并释放出一连串的致命斩击。
zh.name: 业珀

en.description: Syam is at home in the hands of a focused warrior. Its Heavy Attacks send forth shockwaves.
en.name: Syam

zh.description: 业珀在专注的战士手中物尽其用。它的重击会发出冲击波。
zh.name: 业珀

en.description: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Power Strike plunges Azothane into the ground to send forth five celestial blades that apply <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>Cold Status and then explode.
en.name: Azothane

zh.description: 溶灵尊会召唤出有远见的战士来扭转战局。使用强力攻击将溶灵尊插入地面，召唤出五道短暂与漂泊者并肩作战的刃气，造成 <DT_FREEZE_COLOR>冰冻异常状态，随即它们便会爆炸。
zh.name: 溶灵尊

en.description: Azothane calls the visionary warrior to turn the tides of battle. Block and melee attack at the same time to plunge Azothane into the ground, damaging nearby enemies with a shockwave and adding to the combo counter.
en.name: Azothane

zh.description: 溶灵尊会召唤出有远见的战士来扭转战局。同时进行格挡和近战攻击来将溶灵尊插入地面，用其冲击波伤害附近的敌人，并增加连击计数。
zh.name: 溶灵尊

en.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
en.name: Dex Dakra

zh.description: 这是莲为第一位从低温催眠中醒来的天诺战士所准备的一份周年纪念礼物。
zh.name: 灵敏达克拉双剑

en.description: With massive charged power and the ability to hit up to five foes in a single swing, the Galatine sword is the heavy artillery of Melee Weapons.
en.name: Galatine

zh.description: 拥有强大蓄气攻击和一次攻击五名敌人的能力，迦伦提恩重剑可称为近身武器中的重炮。
zh.name: 迦伦提恩

en.description: A strong blade capable of inflicting <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Damage to its foes.
en.name: Heat Sword

zh.description: 其强力的刀刃能对敌人造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割伤害。
zh.name: 烈焰长剑

en.description: A blade with a serrated edge that delivers strong quick attacks.
en.name: Jaw Sword

zh.description: 拥有锯齿状的刀刃，能够施以强力斩击。
zh.name: 蛇颚刀

en.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the eleventh anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
en.name: Dex Nikana

zh.description: 这是莲为第一位从低温催眠中醒来的天诺战士所准备的一份 11 周年纪念礼物。
zh.name: 灵敏侍刃

en.description: The Nikana reintroduces a lost Tenno blade and with it another fragment of the old ways.
en.name: Nikana

zh.description: 利用远古技艺重铸失传的天诺战士刀刃，使侍刃武士刀重新展现。
zh.name: 侍刃

en.description: The Dragon Nikana is forged from ancient Tenno steel. This is a master's weapon, only the most worthy of Tenno may wield it.
en.name: Dragon Nikana

zh.description: 龙之侍刃是以古代天诺战士特制的钢铁所铸成。这是大师的武器，只有武艺修为能与之相配的天诺战士能使用它。
zh.name: 龙之侍刃

en.description: The Nikana reintroduces a lost Tenno blade and with it another fragment of the old ways.
en.name: Nikana Variant

zh.description: 利用远古技艺重铸失传的天诺战士刀刃，使侍刃武士刀重新展现。
zh.name: 侍刃变体

en.description: Once the blade weapon of choice for an exclusive order of Tenno assassins, the Karyst dagger grew to become a symbol of honor and duty for all Tenno.
en.name: Karyst

zh.description: 这曾是一个门第严格的天诺刺客工会的特制武器，凯洛斯特匕首后来渐渐成为了所有天诺战士的荣耀与使命的象征。
zh.name: 凯洛斯特

en.description: The sword the fabled Orokin executioner Nihil used to glass the condemned. Swing while Aim Gliding to glass enemies. A Ground Slam will smash nearby glassed foes, while sending forward a narrow shockwave to shatter distant ones. A Heavy Slam sends forth a wider shockwave with greater force.
en.name: Vitrica

zh.description: 传说中的奥罗金行刑者无刹，用这把剑来将犯人玻璃化。在飞身瞄准时挥动攻击可以使敌人玻璃化。震地攻击将击碎附近玻璃化的敌人，同时向前放出一道冲击窄波，来击碎远处的敌人。重型震地攻击则会放出威力更大且更宽的冲击波。
zh.name: 金璃剑

en.description: Take mastery to the next level with this primed rapier.
en.name: Destreza Prime

zh.description: 用这把圣装细剑将对技巧的掌握提升至更高等级。
zh.name: 圣装技巧之剑

en.description: A unique blade used by an old Tenno clan.
en.name: Pangolin Sword

zh.description: 古老天诺战士氏族所使用的独特刀刃​​。
zh.name: 鲮鲤剑

en.description: An advanced blade that delivers high-damage attacks. Delivers a high percentage of critical strikes.
en.name: Plasma Sword

zh.description: 这是一把先进的武器，有着高蓄力伤害和暴击几率。
zh.name: 等离子长剑

en.description: The hunted will meet a quick end when faced with Khora Prime's signature swords. Heavy Attack Efficiency is enhanced when wielded by Khora.
en.name: Dual Keres Prime

zh.description: 当猎物面对圣装荒野猎手的标志性双刀时，生命将迅速终结。荒野猎手挥舞双刀时，其重击效率会被增强。
zh.name: 圣装凯瑞斯双刀

en.description: Only Tenno were strong enough to wield this noble beast of a weapon.
en.name: Galatine Prime

zh.description: 只有天诺战士才足以运用这把高尚野兽般的武器。
zh.name: 圣装迦伦提恩

en.description: Born anew, the father of swords returns.
en.name: Gram Prime

zh.description: 全然新生，诸剑之祖已经回归。
zh.name: 圣装格拉姆

en.description: This master blade is the heavier, oversized and far more lethal version of the signature weapon of an extinct order of Tenno assassins.
en.name: Karyst Prime

zh.description: 作为一群已绝迹的天诺刺客的标志性武器，这把大师之刃比原版显得更厚重、更大，以及更为致命。
zh.name: 圣装凯洛斯特

en.description: An ancient blade predating the fall of the Orokin Empire. Forged using techniques lost over the centuries, the edge remains sharper than that of any modern Nikana.
en.name: Nikana Prime

zh.description: 远在奥罗金帝国灭亡之前即存在的古老刀刃。以失落的技术所锻冶之刀锋，至今仍比当代各型侍刃来的锐利。
zh.name: 圣装侍刃

en.description: A greatsword for those with an insatiable hunger for victory. Grendel is immune to crowd-control when he performs Heavy Attacks with this weapon.
en.name: Masseter Prime

zh.description: 为那些渴求胜利的人所打造巨剑。当暴食者使用这把武器进行重击时，他能够免疫群体控制技能。
zh.name: 圣装咀嚼金杖

en.description: Forged by a forgotten master, these exquisite blades are bounty from a golden-age long gone.
en.name: Nami Skyla Prime

zh.description: 由一位被遗忘的大师所锻造，这对精致的刀刃是来自那早已消失的黄金时代的财宝。
zh.name: 圣装海波斯库拉对剑

en.description: Enforce authority with these fine-edged sai blades.
en.name: Okina Prime

zh.description: 通过这些精细的锋刃彰显权力。
zh.name: 圣装三叉刺

en.description: A classic Tenno blade, beautifully reimagined.
en.name: Pangolin Prime

zh.description: 天诺战士的经典剑刃，经过精美重制。
zh.name: 圣装鲮鲤剑

en.description: Tatsu Prime glows with spectral splendor. It grows more powerful with each enemy’s demise, especially when wielded by Revenant.
en.name: Tatsu Prime

zh.description: 圣装龙辰闪着幽光。每一个刀下亡魂都会让它的光更闪耀，尤其是在为徘徊夜灵所用的时候。
zh.name: 圣装龙辰

en.description: The blade of the world-destroyer reaches its apotheosis, severing conflict itself. In forging this weapon, you have brought unrealized dreams to their ultimate conclusion.
en.name: War Prime

zh.description: 灭世之刃终于完成升华，锋芒所至，连战争与冲突本身都被斩断。锻造此武器的同时，你也让那些未能实现的梦想迎来了最终的结局。
zh.name: 圣装战争之剑

en.description: Tear through any target with these vicious, claw-like blades. The signature swords of Khora.
en.name: Dual Keres

zh.description: 用这恶毒的爪状刀片撕开任何目标。荒野猎手的标志性刀剑。
zh.name: 凯瑞斯双刀

en.description: Forged for veterans of the Scarlet Spear conflict, this Lacera has been modified to enhance nimbleness and lethality.
en.name: Ceti Lacera

zh.description: 这款专为参与猩红之矛战役的老将所打造的悲痛之刃，经过了改造以提高敏捷性和杀伤力。
zh.name: 天仓·悲痛之刃

en.description: In the practiced hands of a master, this blade and whip becomes exceedingly devastating.
en.name: Lacera

zh.description: 在熟练的大师手中，这把剑鞭极具毁灭性。
zh.name: 悲痛之刃

en.description: The Stalker's sword as bestowed on him by the Sentient Hunhow.
en.name: War

zh.description: 这把追猎者的剑是魂侯赐予给他的。
zh.name: 战争之剑

en.description: A fragment of Stalker's War sword, a symbol of his defeat.
en.name: Broken War

zh.description: 追猎者的战争之剑的碎片，是其落败的象征。
zh.name: 破碎的战争之剑

en.description: Perforate enemies with these two needle-sharp sai.
en.name: Okina

zh.description: 用这把两端带有尖刺的十手来刺穿敌人。
zh.name: 三叉刺

en.description: The delicate form of this Tenno rapier conceals its ferocious and resilient force.
en.name: Endura

zh.description: 这把天诺细剑的精巧外形让它的凶猛而富有弹性的力量藏而不露。
zh.name: 三叶坚韧

en.description: Tear and chew through enemies with this unusual crankshaft-style greatsword. When wielded by Grendel he is immune to staggers and knockdowns during heavy attacks.
en.name: Masseter

zh.description: 用这把不寻常的，曲轴风格巨剑撕破并嚼碎敌人的骨肉。在暴食者的控制下，他在进行重击时不会受到失衡和击倒的影响。
zh.name: 咀嚼金杖

en.description: After 10 kills or assists, Dorrclave enters a spectral state that doubles weapon Follow Through and guarantees Status Effects for the next 10 attacks. In Dagath's hands, each active Status Effect heals her slightly.
en.name: Dorrclave

zh.description: 在 10 次消灭或助攻后，怒斩进入光谱状态，使得武器伤害穿透系数加倍，并且接下来的 10 次攻击必定造成异常状态。如果是无面骑影使用，每个激活的状态效果都会轻微治疗她。
zh.name: 怒斩

en.description: The steel flag of Old War Railjack crews, the Pennant was invaluable in repelling boarders. With each heavy attack kill the Pennant's speed of attack increases.
en.name: Pennant

zh.description: 远古之战航道星舰舰员的钢铁旗帜。这个尖幡在击退登舰敌人时十分有用。每一个重击消灭都会提高尖幡的攻击速度。
zh.name: 尖幡

en.description: Fearsome and noble, the elegant two-handed Nikana is the pride of any Arsenal. Kills build charges and seeking projectiles are unleashed with a Slide Attack to find and stun unwitting enemies. When Revenant wields this blade, Tatsu's charge cap is increased.
en.name: Tatsu

zh.description: 尊贵而令人畏惧，这把优雅的双手侍刃是任何军械库里的骄傲。击杀可以蓄能，而在施展滑行攻击时，积蓄的能量会转化为投射物，追踪并击晕那些浑然不觉的敌人。在被徘徊夜灵使用时，龙辰的蓄能次数上限会得到提升。
zh.name: 龙辰

en.description: Elevate martial combat into an art form with this Tenno rapier.
en.name: Destreza

zh.description: 用这把天诺细剑以艺术的方式来提升武术战斗技巧。
zh.name: 技巧之剑

en.description: Forged of steel grafted from Umbra's flesh, this elegant Nikana unites with its Warframe to form a single being of seething purpose.
en.name: Skiajati

zh.description: 这把优雅的侍刃从暗影圣剑肉体移植的钢材锻造而成，并与其战甲结合形成拥有沸腾意志的整体。
zh.name: 影生

en.description: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Block to activate its staggering energy shield. Power Strike stuns enemies and inflicts <DT_SLASH_COLOR>Slash Status. Perfect Parry restores your Power Strike.
en.name: Argo & Vel

zh.description: 星舟 & 帆为坚忍不拔的战士提供支持。格挡以激活其惊人的能量护盾。强力攻击会击晕敌人并造成 <DT_SLASH_COLOR>切割异常状态。完美招架可重置强力攻击的冷却时间。
zh.name: 星舟 & 帆

en.description: Argo & Vel bolster the warrior who stands fast. Its Heavy Attack sends forth a glaive that ricochets off enemies.
en.name: Argo & Vel

zh.description: 星舟 & 帆为坚守阵地的战士提供支持。它的重击会射出一把会在敌人身上弹开的刀刃。
zh.name: 星舟 & 帆

en.description: This fiery sword and shield combination perfects the balance of Tenno offense and defense prowess. In the hands of a Master, even a defensive tool like a shield can be used as a weapon.
en.name: Silva & Aegis

zh.description: 这一火焰般的剑盾组合使天诺战士的攻击与防御技艺取得完美的平衡。在大师的手中，就连盾牌这样的防御工具也能被用作武器。
zh.name: 席瓦 & 神盾

en.description: Take active defense to new heights with this deadly flying shield and brutal blade. Throw the shield with a unique Heavy Attack, inflicting Blast Status Effects and dealing damage in a wide area.
en.name: Tak & Lug

zh.description: 这套残暴而致命的剑盾组合完美展示了最好的防守就是进攻。通过独特的重击可投掷出盾牌，造成爆炸异常状态和大范围伤害。
zh.name: 塔克 & 卢格

en.description: Baruuk's signature weapons: a sword for retribution, a shield for restraint. In Baruuk's hands, and his hands only, Cobra's first strike in a combo renders his foe unconscious.
en.name: Cobra & Crane

zh.description: 圣拳武僧的标志性武器：代表报应的剑，以及象征克制的盾。唯有在圣拳武僧的手中，眼镜蛇招式中的第一次打击可使敌人失去意识。
zh.name: 眼镜蛇 & 鹤

en.description: Punish those who test your restraint. The first strike in a combo stuns enemies when Cobra & Crane Prime are wielded by Baruuk.
en.name: Cobra & Crane Prime

zh.description: 向那些考验你克制力的人施予惩罚。在被圣拳武僧使用时，圣装眼镜蛇 & 鹤连击中的第一击可以眩晕敌人。
zh.name: 圣装眼镜蛇 & 鹤

en.description: Deadly slashes from the Sigma sword are matched only by the force of the Octantis shield when thrown from the air.
en.name: Sigma & Octantis

zh.description: 西格玛剑的致命切砍唯有南极座空中掷出的力量能与之匹敌。
zh.name: 西格玛 & 南极座

en.description: An intimidating Tonfa set designed to match the briary design of the Boltor.
en.name: Boltace

zh.description: 一对设计成与满身尖刺为造型的螺钉步枪相辅相成的拐刃，有着令人生畏的外观。
zh.name: 螺钉拐刃

en.description: The Kronen resurrects a lethal fighting style once thought lost to the ages.
en.name: Kronen

zh.description: 皇家拐刃重现了一度被认为已失落于长久岁月中的致命战斗风格。
zh.name: 皇家拐刃

en.description: Ancient blades, perfected for today’s combat.
en.name: Kronen Prime

zh.description: 远古之刃，但完美契合今日的战斗。
zh.name: 圣装皇家拐刃

en.description: Command the beauty and lethality of these ornate warfans.
en.name: Gunsen Prime

zh.description: 让这对华丽的武扇彰显其绝美的杀伤力。
zh.name: 圣装军扇

en.description: Wield Xaku Prime’s elegant fan, its gilded edges crafted for both precision and prestige.
en.name: Quassus Prime

zh.description: 挥舞着圣装虚空残响的优雅扇子，它的镀金边缘尽显精密与尊贵。
zh.name: 圣装威震武扇

en.description: Flick away the enemy with this heavy warfan. The Quassus scatters ethereal daggers that are even more deadly accurate when wielded by Xaku.
en.name: Quassus

zh.description: 用这把重型武扇拂开敌人。威震武扇会散射出轻巧的匕首，在虚空残响的挥舞下将更为致命精准。
zh.name: 威震武扇

en.description: Unfurl this warfan like a rapidly waxing moon.
en.name: Vericres

zh.description: 展开这把武扇，就如一弯快速升起的上弦月。
zh.name: 真月武扇

en.description: Lacerate attackers with two razor sharp warfans.
en.name: Gunsen

zh.description: 用两把带有锐利剃刀的军扇来撕碎攻击者。
zh.name: 军扇

en.description: Each lash of Oraxia's whip injects its victim with a dose of deadly toxin. Upon death, afflicted enemies have a chance to burst, damaging nearby enemies and spreading the poison.
en.name: Spinnerex

zh.description: 缚影蛛后的每一次鞭打都会将致命毒素注入敌人体内，受影响的敌人死亡时爆发毒素，对附近的敌人造成伤害并扩散毒素。
zh.name: 丝蛛皇

en.description: The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.
en.name: Furis

zh.description: 盗贼是一把自动手枪，这小东西拥有极高的射速。
zh.name: 盗贼

en.description: The Furis delivers a high damage output in a short time frame thanks to its high rate of fire.
en.name: Furis Variant

zh.description: 盗贼是一把自动手枪，这小东西拥有极高的射速。
zh.name: 盗贼变体

en.description: Infused with rare Orokin alloys, the Bronco Prime is a highly efficient weapon, trading an increased Magazine Capacity and damage for a lower rate of fire.
en.name: Bronco Prime

zh.description: 加入罕见的奥罗金合金，圣装野马是一把高效能武器，以射速为代价，提高装弹量和伤害力。
zh.name: 圣装野马

en.description: The Sicarus fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.
en.name: Sicarus

zh.description: 暗杀者是三发点射手枪，在连发手枪的杀伤力和单发手枪的准确度之间取得平衡。
zh.name: 暗杀者

en.description: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.
en.name: Lato

zh.description: 拉托是一款被天诺战士广泛使用的高精度手枪。
zh.name: 拉托

en.description: The Bolto fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.
en.name: Bolto

zh.description: 螺钉手枪连射速度缓慢，大型的螺钉能把敌人钉在墙上。
zh.name: 螺钉手枪

en.description: The Bronco is a small-scale shotgun that can be wielded with one hand. Only effective at close range, it has a limited Magazine Capacity.
en.name: Bronco

zh.description: 野马是可以单手操作的小型霰弹枪。在近距离有效但弹匣容量较少。
zh.name: 野马

en.description: The Bronco is a small-scale shotgun that can be wielded with one hand. Only effective at close range, it has a limited Magazine Capacity.
en.name: Bronco Variant

zh.description: 野马是可以单手操作的小型霰弹枪。在近距离有效但弹匣容量较少。
zh.name: 野马变体

en.description: The Lex is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.
en.name: Lex

zh.description: 雷克斯是大火力的手枪，射速和弹匣容量都很低，但每发伤害很高。
zh.name: 雷克斯

en.description: The Lex is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.
en.name: Lex Variant

zh.description: 雷克斯是大火力的手枪，射速和弹匣容量都很低，但每发伤害很高。
zh.name: 雷克斯变体

en.description: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere. Prime model offers slightly increased damage.
en.name: Lato Prime

zh.description: 拉托是半自动手枪。其高精度深受天诺战士喜爱。圣装版本拥有稍高的伤害。
zh.name: 圣装拉托

en.description: A special version of the standard Lato pistol with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher Accuracy and Damage values. The Lato Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.
en.name: Lato Vandal

zh.description: 拉托的特别版，射速略低但伤害和精准度更高。拉托·破坏者被天诺战士定制成蓝绿色金属光泽，并在握把上绘制了莲的纹样。
zh.name: 拉托·破坏者

en.description: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.
en.name: Lato

zh.description: 拉托是一款被天诺战士广泛使用的高精度手枪。
zh.name: 拉托

en.description: The Lato is a highly accurate pistol used by the Tenno everywhere.
en.name: Lato Variant

zh.description: 拉托是一款被天诺战士广泛使用的高精度手枪。
zh.name: 拉托变体

en.description: Steady and reliable, the Vasto revolver combines speed and power for a classic gunslinger feel.
en.name: Vasto

zh.description: 稳定、可靠。这把瓦斯托左轮手枪结合了速度与力量，呈现出经典的神枪手意象。
zh.name: 瓦斯托

en.description: Never stop fighting, never run out of ammo. Temple's signature machine pistol was modified by Albrecht Entrati to warp fired bullets back into the magazine when reloaded.
en.name: Riot-848

zh.description: 弹药无穷无尽，战斗至死方休。赤焰狂歌的标志性连发手枪经过阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的改造，装填时，被消耗的子弹会重新回到弹匣中。
zh.name: 暴乱-848

en.description: Banshee Prime's signature shotgun is an instrument of devastation that fires both focused and broad shots.
en.name: Euphona Prime

zh.description: 圣装恸哭女妖的标志性霰弹枪是把可射出集中和散射子弹的破坏性武器。
zh.name: 圣装悦音

en.description: The Ballistica crossbow features a unique dual firing mechanism. Choose between a four bolt volley or a deadly accurate charged shot.
en.name: Ballistica

zh.description: 这把布里斯提卡连弩采用独特的双击发装置，可在四连发或蓄力使用精准的致命射击之间选择。
zh.name: 布里斯提卡

en.description: Hammer the enemy with this light-bodied heavy hitter. Featuring a double-action trigger that fires hard and fast.
en.name: Zylok

zh.description: 用这把轻盈的重击手猛击敌人。具有复动式扳机，可以快速、猛烈地发射。
zh.name: 席尔火枪

en.description: A gift from the Lotus to commemorate the anniversary of the first Tenno waking from Cryo stasis.
en.name: Dex Furis

zh.description: 这是莲为第一位从低温催眠中醒来的天诺战士所准备的一份周年纪念礼物。
zh.name: 灵敏盗贼双枪

zh.description: 舞霜剑姬的标志性手枪威力十足，如同凛冬的寒风。每次装填都会释放出一道寒冷的脉冲，使敌人陷入冰冻异常状态，脉冲的范围会随着装填次数的增加而扩大。
zh.name: 寒怨刺

en.description: The choice weapon of Mirage, these fast-firing dual pistols deliver a deadly performance.
en.name: Akzani

zh.description: 作为魅影精灵战甲的精选武器，这些高射速的双手枪将为您带来一场致命的演出。
zh.name: 荒谬双枪

en.description: The versatile Magnus revolver is a lethal sidearm for any Tenno.
en.name: Magnus

zh.description: 多功能麦格努斯左轮手枪对于任何天诺战士来说都是一把能置对手于死地的手枪。
zh.name: 麦格努斯

en.description: Vanquish chaos with dual firepower.
en.name: Afuris Prime

zh.description: 以双重火力征服混乱。
zh.name: 圣装盗贼双枪

en.description: Wield a golden pair of rocket launchers. Sprint to reload them faster. They reload fastest when wielded by Gauss.
en.name: Akarius Prime

zh.description: 挥舞一对金色火箭发射器。冲刺可加快装填速度。搭配迅电驰影使用时，其装填速度最快。
zh.name: 圣装阿利乌双枪

en.description: Gilded rails adorn these two vicious bolt launching pistols.
en.name: Akbolto Prime

zh.description: 镀金的导轨装饰着这对凶猛的钉枪。
zh.name: 圣装螺钉双枪

en.description: Precision machined mirrored pistols. Primed and ready.
en.name: Akjagara Prime

zh.description: 精密加工的镜像手枪。填装完毕并蓄势待发。
zh.name: 圣装觉醒双枪

en.description: The elegant Aksomati precisely refined to this, their ultimate manifestation.
en.name: Aksomati Prime

zh.description: 优雅的轻灵月神双枪精准定义了它们的终极表现。
zh.name: 圣装轻灵月神双枪

en.description: Stylish, discreet and accurate, perfect for the Tenno of distinction.
en.name: Akstiletto Prime

zh.description: 时尚、稳定而精准，非常适合那些喜欢与众不同的天诺战士们。
zh.name: 圣装史提托双枪

en.description: Unleash the song of the righteous warrior with this gilded pistol that goes into Overdrive on Weak Point kills, maximizing fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.
en.name: Athodai Prime

zh.description: 用这把镀金手枪释放正义战士的怒吼，弱点击杀后即可进入超负荷模式，短时间内大幅提升射速和弹药效率。
zh.name: 圣装阿索代

en.description: The beauty of this luxuriously gilded crossbow cannot obscure its lethal purpose.
en.name: Ballistica Prime

zh.description: 这款豪华镀金连弩的精美无法遮掩它致命的目的。
zh.name: 圣装布里斯提卡

en.description: Send shivers down your enemies' spines with this wrist-mounted sidearm. As the signature weapon of Sevagoth Prime, it deals additional headshot damage when wielded by him.
en.name: Epitaph Prime

zh.description: 这把腕式副武器让你的敌人不寒而栗。作为圣装虚冥鬼影的标志性武器，由他使用时可造成额外的击中头部伤害。
zh.name: 圣装葬铭

en.description: Versatile weapons complement deadly hunters. Khora Prime’s signature pistol rotates through hot, cold, electric, and toxic quills. When equipped on Khora, Hystrix Prime has a chance to instantly reload after headshots.
en.name: Hystrix Prime

zh.description: 灵活多变的武器与致命的猎人相得益彰。圣装荒野猎手的标志性手枪可在火焰、冰冻、电击和毒素刺镖中轮换。当荒野猎手装备上圣装豪猪并造成爆头时，则弹药有几率立即重新装填。
zh.name: 圣装豪猪

en.description: Ring a funeral toll upon enemy skulls with Harrow Prime's signature pistol.
en.name: Knell Prime

zh.description: 用圣装驱魔使者的标志性手枪在敌人的头颅上敲响葬礼的钟声。
zh.name: 圣装丧钟

en.description: Glinting like a golden dawn, Yareli Prime’s signature pistol engulfs foes in a cascade of virulent, explosive, water globules. None can escape the sea.
en.name: Kompressa Prime

zh.description: 圣装咏浪之灵的标志性手枪闪耀着金色黎明般的光芒，将敌人吞噬在一连串的剧毒、爆炸性水弹中。没有人能逃出这片水域。
zh.name: 圣装卡帕压力枪

en.description: The Lex Prime is a powerful, accurate pistol that has a low Fire Rate and Magazine Capacity. Very efficient at long range.
en.name: Lex Prime

zh.description: 圣装雷克斯是一把强大且精准的手枪，虽然有着射速慢和弹匣小的缺点，但在远距离作战时非常出色。
zh.name: 圣装雷克斯

en.description: Orokin elegance meets formidable stopping power in this exquisite revolver. Hits have a chance to maximize Ammo Efficiency for a few seconds.
en.name: Magnus Prime

zh.description: 奥罗金的优雅与强大制动力在这把精致的左轮手枪中相遇。命中时有几率在数秒内最大化弹药效率。
zh.name: 圣装麦格努斯

en.description: Pound the beat for a dance of death with Octavia's signature prime pistol.
en.name: Pandero Prime

zh.description: 以这把吟游歌者的标志性圣装手枪，为死亡之舞敲奏节拍。
zh.name: 圣装手鼓

en.description: Three kills in rapid succession to summon a second ethereal Pyrana for twice the deadly punch.
en.name: Pyrana Prime

zh.description: 快速地连续 3 次消灭将召唤一把食人鱼的幻影，造成双倍的致命杀伤。
zh.name: 圣装食人鱼

en.description: The Sicarus Prime is an ornamental firearm that fires rounds in rapid bursts, providing a balance between the lethality of auto-pistols and the accuracy of semi-automatic pistols.
en.name: Sicarus Prime

zh.description: 圣装暗杀者是一把快速点射的装饰性武器，在连发手枪的杀伤力和单发手枪的准确度之间取得平衡。
zh.name: 圣装暗杀者

en.description: Orokin craftsmanship married with superior firepower. Dual Vastos, primed and ready to strike.
en.name: Akvasto Prime

zh.description: 奥罗金精湛工艺与出众火力的结合。两把瓦斯托，已经装弹待发。
zh.name: 圣装瓦斯托双枪

en.description: This elegant rapid-fire revolver is the embodiment of superior Orokin craftsmanship.
en.name: Vasto Prime

zh.description: 这把优雅的速射左轮手枪，正是奥罗金卓越工艺设计的体现。
zh.name: 圣装瓦斯托

en.description: This sidearm’s circular design evokes Protea Prime’s perception of time.
en.name: Velox Prime

zh.description: 这把副武器的圆形设计唤起了圣装泊时灵械对时间的感知。
zh.name: 圣装逐电

en.description: A thousand pains, before their end.
en.name: Zakti Prime

zh.description: 在他们临终之前，使其受尽千般痛苦。
zh.name: 圣装毒芽

en.description: A lightweight weapon that packs a punch worthy of its golden design.
en.name: Zylok Prime

zh.description: 看似轻巧的武器，却有着与其金色设计相称的巨大威力。
zh.name: 圣装席尔火枪

en.description: Heat, cold, electricity, or toxin: choose an element and launch a flurry of deadly quills. This versatile sidearm is Khora’s signature weapon and has a chance to instantly reload after headshots when she wields it.
en.name: Hystrix

zh.description: 火焰、冰冻、电击或者毒素：选择一种元素并发射出一簇簇致命的刺镖。这款灵活多变的副武器是荒野猎手的标志性武器。当她使用豪猪时，爆头有几率使弹药重新装填。
zh.name: 豪猪

en.description: Bombard legions of enemies with target seeking rockets. These dual launchers reload faster while sprinting, even more so in Gauss’ hands. Rockets arm after reaching a safe distance.
en.name: Akarius

zh.description: 使用目标追踪火箭弹轰击成群的敌人。冲刺时可以更快地装填弹匣，在迅电驰影手里效果更加显著。火箭会在离开安全距离后爆炸。
zh.name: 阿利乌双枪

en.description: Chew through the enemy with this vicious automatic hand shotgun.
en.name: Pyrana

zh.description: 用这把凶恶的自动霰弹手枪咬穿敌人。
zh.name: 食人鱼

en.description: The devastating power of the Soma rifle compacted into two elegant pistols.
en.name: Aksomati

zh.description: 月神步枪的强大威力被凝聚在这对优雅的手枪当中。
zh.name: 轻灵月神双枪

en.description: This intricate automatic pistol is able to fire its magazine which then spins in the air for a short time, firing lasers at nearby enemies.
en.name: Azima

zh.description: 这把构造错综复杂的自动手枪能射出其弹匣，同时在空中旋转的弹匣短时间内会击发激光攻击附近的敌人。
zh.name: 方位角

en.description: These diminutive rapid-fire Stiletto machine-pistols are just the right size to be akimbo style without sacrificing accuracy.
en.name: Akstiletto

zh.description: 这对小巧，能快速击发的史提托全自动手枪，其恰如其分的尺寸既能双持射击又不失精准度。
zh.name: 史提托双枪

en.description: The design of these hard-hitting dual pistols is a mix of organic and bladed elements.
en.name: Akjagara

zh.description: 这组重击双手枪的设计是有机体和刀片元素的结合。
zh.name: 觉醒双枪

en.description: Octavia's pistol hammers foes with single shots or a rapid volley of bullets. When wielded by Octavia, alt-fire Headshot Kills increase Reload Speed.
en.name: Pandero

zh.description: 吟游歌者的手枪以单发或迅速齐发的方式将子弹打入敌人体内。在被吟游歌者使用时，由次要射击模式所造成的击中头部消灭会提升装填速度。
zh.name: 手鼓

en.description: Fires razor-sharp darts that anchor themselves in their target before erupting in a plume of toxic gas.
en.name: Zakti

zh.description: 可以发射如剃刀般锋利的飞镖固定在目标上，接着喷发出一股有毒气体。
zh.name: 毒芽

en.description: Reverse-engineered from propulsion tech this hand-cannon packs a kick. Weak Point kills trigger Overdrive, locking off secondary functions while maximizing your fire rate and ammo efficiency for a short time.
en.name: Athodai

zh.description: 这款强力手枪由喷射推进器技术逆向设计而成。爆头消灭会触发超载状态，该状态将关闭次要射击功能，以在短时间内最大化你的射速和弹药效率。
zh.name: 阿索代

en.description: With a high fire rate, ammo efficiency and rapid reload when emptied, this unusual sidearm can hand out carnage all day long. Ammo efficiency is further increased when Protea uses this, her signature weapon.
en.name: Velox

zh.description: 在高射速、高弹药效率以及高装填速度的加持下，这把非比寻常的副武器能昼夜无休地大杀四方。作为泊时灵械的标志性武器，弹药效率会在泊时灵械使用它时更进一步地提升。
zh.name: 逐电

en.description: Ring the death knell. Headshots briefly turn this scoped pistol into a rapid-fire, Critical Damage fiend that uses no ammo. When used by Harrow, Knell has a 2-round mag.
en.name: Knell

zh.description: 鸣响死神的丧钟。击中头部可短暂地将这把带瞄准镜的手枪变成快速击发，不消耗弹药的暴击伤害恶魔。在被驱魔使者使用时，丧钟会拥有双发弹匣。
zh.name: 丧钟

en.description: Sevagoth's wrist-mounted sidearm fires a chilling slow-moving slab, guaranteed to slow enemies for easier marksmanship. Charge the shot to fire a punishing high-velocity, high critical chance slab that punches through barriers. Deals additional headshot damage in Sevagoth's hands.
en.name: Epitaph

zh.description: 虚冥鬼影的腕式副武器可以发射令人胆寒的慢速移动石板，石板可以减缓敌人的速度，以更轻松地瞄准敌人。蓄力射击可发射一个惩戒性的高速、高暴击几率的石板，石板可击穿障碍物。在虚冥鬼影手中可造成额外的击中头部伤害。
zh.name: 葬铭

en.description: Launch a volley of virulent, hyper-pressurized, water globules that envelope targets and explode with torrential force. Yareli's signature pistol.
en.name: Kompressa

zh.description: 发射一连串的剧毒高压水弹，包围目标并剧烈爆炸。咏浪之灵的标志性手枪。
zh.name: 卡帕压力枪

en.description: The Boltor fires slow, heavy bolts that are capable of impaling enemies to walls.
en.name: Boltor

zh.description: 螺钉步枪所发射出的慢速重型螺钉足以将敌人钉在墙上。
zh.name: 螺钉步枪

en.description: A classic Orokin weapon, Braton Prime features modified damage levels and a larger magazine over the standard model.
en.name: Braton Prime

zh.description: 一把经典的奥罗金兵器，圣装布莱顿比起标准版，强化了伤害能力以及更大的弹匣。
zh.name: 圣装布莱顿

en.description: The Burston fires 3-round bursts, which provides a balance between the lethality of automatic rifles and the accuracy of semi-automatic rifles.
en.name: Burston

zh.description: 伯斯顿是三发点射步枪，在机枪的杀伤力和半自动的准确度之间取得平衡。
zh.name: 伯斯顿

en.description: The Gorgon sports a large magazine that allows it to provide suppressing fire and sustain a high damage rate over a long time. Its high Fire Rate is only achieved following a short wind-up cycle.
en.name: Gorgon

zh.description: 蛇发女妖是一把重机枪。巨大的弹匣使它能够提供压制火力并长时间维持高伤害率。
zh.name: 蛇发女妖

en.description: The ornamental Latron Prime exploits ancient Orokin technology to get a slight damage increase over the standard Latron.
en.name: Latron Prime

zh.description: 这把经过装饰的圣装拉特昂利用了远古的奥罗金技术，拥有比标准版拉特昂还高的伤害。
zh.name: 圣装拉特昂

en.description: The Braton's high rate of fire and accuracy make it a favorite among the Tenno.
en.name: Braton

zh.description: 布莱顿是一支自动步枪。高射速和高精度使其成为了天诺战士的最爱。
zh.name: 布莱顿

en.description: The Latron is a highly efficient rifle that performs well at medium and at long range, its accuracy making it a deadly weapon in the hands of skilled marksmen.
en.name: Latron

zh.description: 拉特昂是一支半自动步枪。其高性能和高准确性令它在一名能精准射击的人手中时可以变得十分致命。
zh.name: 拉特昂

en.description: Manufactured by the Corpus, the Snipetron is a powerful and accurate rifle that sports optical zoom capabilities. Perfect for long range engagements.
en.name: Snipetron

zh.description: 由科普斯商会加工，狙击特昂是一把具备变焦能力的强力精准步枪。适合远距离战斗。
zh.name: 狙击特昂

en.description: The MK1-Braton is the standard issue rifle for all Tenno. A versatile weapon that can be customized to support a wide variety of play styles.
en.name: MK1-Braton

zh.description: 试用型-布莱顿是天诺战士的标准配置步枪，是一把可被定制化以支援各种使用风格的多功能武器。
zh.name: 试用型-布莱顿

en.description: Accuracy coupled with a massive magazine makes the Soma assault rifle a formidable weapon.
en.name: Soma

zh.description: 高准度与高容量弹匣的结合，使月神突击步枪成为强大的武器。
zh.name: 月神

en.description: A classic Tenno sniper rifle, the Vectis is ideal for ranged takedowns.
en.name: Vectis

zh.description: 守望者是把适于远距消灭敌人的理想武器，一把天诺的经典狙击步枪。
zh.name: 守望者

en.description: A special version of the standard Braton rifle with a slower Fire Rate but offering higher accuracy and damage values. The Braton Vandal has been customized by the Tenno with a blue-green metallic finish and Lotus branding on the grips.
en.name: Braton Vandal

zh.description: 布莱顿的特别版本，有着较低的射速，但更高的精准度和伤害。布莱顿·破坏者被天诺战士定制成蓝绿色金属光泽，并在握把上绘制了莲的纹样。
zh.name: 布莱顿·破坏者

en.description: A customized version of the elusive Snipetron, with metallic finish and Lotus decal.
en.name: Snipetron Vandal

zh.description: 这把狙击特昂是少见的定制化版本，拥有金属质感及莲花徽记。
zh.name: 狙击特昂·破坏者

en.description: Sobek is a rapid-firing Grineer shotgun that has reduced damage per shot but boasts extra large magazine capacity.
en.name: Sobek

zh.description: 鳄神是一把速射型克隆尼霰弹枪，虽降低每一枪的伤害，但拥有超大弹匣容量。
zh.name: 鳄神

en.description: A shotgun with low accuracy and strong recoil, but able to deliver its payload in full-auto. The Boar is best used at close range.
en.name: Boar

zh.description: 野猪有着较低的精度和大后坐力，但可以全自动发射载弹。最适宜近距离使用。
zh.name: 野猪

en.description: One of the finest examples of Tenno craftsmanship, the Boar Prime offers a higher Fire Rate, Magazine Capacity and a much higher per-shot damage.
en.name: Boar Prime

zh.description: 天诺工艺设计的绝佳案例之一，圣装野猪能提供更快的射击速度、更大的弹匣容量，以及更高的子弹伤害。
zh.name: 圣装野猪

en.description: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.
en.name: Hek

zh.description: 海克是一把能发射密集弹丸的强力霰弹枪，只要能驾驭其猛烈后坐力，在中距离战斗也能有效发挥。
zh.name: 海克

en.description: The Hek is a powerful shotgun that fires its shots with a tight spread, making it efficient at medium range as long as its strong recoil is properly managed.
en.name: Hek

zh.description: 海克是一把能发射密集弹丸的强力霰弹枪，只要能驾驭其猛烈后坐力，在中距离战斗也能有效发挥。
zh.name: 海克

en.description: The Strun is a standard shotgun. Reliable, versatile and deadly.
en.name: Strun

zh.description: 斯特朗是一把标准的霰弹枪，可靠，灵活，致命。
zh.name: 斯特朗

en.description: A different take on a familiar shotgun, the Strun Wraith features unique styling.
en.name: Strun Wraith

zh.description: 熟知霰弹枪截然不同的造型，红莲斯特朗拥有着相当特殊的风格。
zh.name: 红莲斯特朗

en.description: Silently lacerate enemies with Gara's signature glass throwing knives. Increased Projectile Speed when wielded by Gara.
en.name: Fusilai

zh.description: 无声地以琉璃仕女的标志性玻璃飞刀撕裂敌人。在被琉璃仕女使用时，该武器的投射物飞行速度会提升。
zh.name: 齐射玻刃

en.description: Kunai throwing daggers offer a silent alternative to the traditional side arm. Perfect for assassins.
en.name: Kunai

zh.description: 苦无以投掷用匕首替代传统副武器的非静音攻击。暗杀首选。
zh.name: 苦无

en.description: A flash of red ribbon is the last thing most victims of these throwing-daggers see.
en.name: Spira

zh.description: 彤红缎带的残影，是这款投掷匕首刃下大多数受害者最后看到的影像。
zh.name: 旋刃飞刀

en.description: These rare, braided throwing daggers were a favorite tool of high ranking Orokin assassins.
en.name: Spira Prime

zh.description: 配置这些罕见的投掷匕首，是奥罗金高阶刺客喜欢的工具。
zh.name: 圣装旋刃飞刀

en.description: As deadly as any bullet without the associated noise or commotion.
en.name: Hikou Prime

zh.description: 如同任何子弹一样致命，且不会引起噪音或骚动。
zh.name: 圣装飞扬

en.description: Used by The Stalker, Despair throwing blades have a mono-filament edge, sharp enough to penetrate a Warframe.
en.name: Despair

zh.description: 追猎者所持的绝望，是丢出由单分子构成的刀刃，足够锋利来穿透战甲。
zh.name: 绝望

en.description: The remotely triggered Castanas quietly deliver a lethal dose of electricity to unsuspecting enemies.
en.name: Castanas

zh.description: 可远程遥控的雷爆信镖会悄悄传递致死剂量的电力给毫无戒备的敌人。
zh.name: 雷爆信镖

en.description: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.
en.name: Hikou

zh.description: 作为苦无的替代方案，飞扬用较低的伤害换得更高的携带量跟更快的射速。
zh.name: 飞扬

en.description:
In moments of despair, let the battle resonate with song. Cantare's blades lodge into the battlefield and return upon reload. When returning blades strike enemies, Cantare empowers allies with increased Reload Speed.

Experience the true power of Jade's Ensemble when Evensong, Cantare, and Harmony sing together.
en.name: Cantare

zh.description:
在绝望的时刻，让歌声响彻战场。歌颂的刃片会扎入战场中，并在重新装填时返回。当返回的刃片击中敌人时，歌颂会增强友军的装填速度。

当晚祷、歌颂与和谐一同奏响时，体验圣天使之合奏真正的力量。
zh.name: 歌颂

en.description: Go on the hunt with Oraxia’s signature secondary. Fling a volley of toxin-laced barbs, or drop a cluster snare that scatters on impact, seizing nearby enemies and dragging them together.
en.name: Scyotid

zh.description: 使用缚影蛛后的标志性副武器进行狩猎。你可以射出一连串充满毒素的倒钩，或者投放一个在撞击时散开的团状陷阱，抓住附近的敌人并将其拖到一起。
zh.name: 镰刃刺

en.description: The claws of these tactical bombs dig into the target and detonate on command.
en.name: Talons

zh.description: 附带的尖锐勾爪能将战术炸弹掘入目标体内并遥控引爆。
zh.name: 鹰爪

en.description: May contain rocks.
en.name: Solstice Spheres

zh.description: 可能包含有岩石。
zh.name: 冬至球

en.description: As an alternative to Kunai, these Tenno throwing stars do cause less Damage but they come with expanded Ammo Capacity and a higher Fire Rate.
en.name: Hikou Variant

zh.description: 作为苦无的替代方案，飞扬用较低的伤害换得更高的携带量跟更快的射速。
zh.name: 飞扬变体

en.description: The Felarx invokes ancient times when aristocrats hunted game. For ceremonies, Orokin elites bred creatures reminiscent of game birds to reanimate cultural myths. They gave the Zariman crew Felarx and a brace of birds as a sign of acceptance into elite society. The brace of birds becomes a pair of pistols at the hands of the Void.
en.name: Felarx

zh.description: 逐枭唤起了古代贵族狩猎活动的历史。为了仪式，奥罗金精英培育出与其狩猎的猛禽相像之生物来重现文化传说。他们赐予「扎里曼号」船员逐枭和一对猛禽，作为接受船员们进入精英社会的标志。而这对猛禽在虚空的作用下变成了一对手枪。
zh.name: 逐枭

en.description: Zariman colonists originally intended to use the Phenmor in burial rites. In Orokin society, the higher the rank, the greater number of volleys for the deceased. Its stock is carved from Phenaureus Pine, a tree designed to release seedlings only onto scorched earth. In the hands of the Void, the Phenmor becomes darkly aggressive.
en.name: Phenmor

zh.description: 扎里曼殖民者们最初是希望在葬礼上使用凤殁的。在奥罗金的社会体系中，越高阶级的逝者葬礼上，人们为了纪念逝者射出的子弹数量就越多。这把武器的枪托由只在焦土上释放幼苗的樟子松雕刻而成。在与虚空的接触中，凤殁充满了阴暗的侵略性。
zh.name: 凤殁

en.description: In the early Orokin Empire, elites wore Innodem as a symbolic reminder to defend the defenseless. The tradition fell out of style, but nostalgic elites acknowledged the sentiment in the form of a gift. The Void amplifies that ideal. Void energy strengthens Innodem gliding aerial attacks and the wielder is increasingly resilient as they perform finisher attacks in Incarnon Form.
en.name: Innodem

zh.description: 在早期的奥罗金帝国，精英们会佩戴清刚作为提醒他们保护手无寸铁者的象征。这种传统早已过时了，但念旧的精英们有时会以礼物的形式认可这种理念。而虚空则放大了这一理念，虚空能量增强了这把武器的滑翔制空攻击之力；当佩戴者在灵化形态下进行处决攻击时，会感受到这把武器增强的韧性。
zh.name: 清刚

en.description: The Thalys played a ceremonial role in the Zariman harvest festival, and was intended to reap the first fruits of Tau. Now twisted from this purpose, it plants Void shards in enemy flesh instead. Each new shard planted causes existing shards to inflict damage on their hosts.
en.name: Thalys

zh.description: 大力士曾在扎里曼收获节中扮演仪式性的角色，原本用来收获陶星系的最初成果。而如今，它的用途已被扭曲，转而在敌人的肉体中播种虚空之种。每种下一颗新种子，现有的碎片便会对宿主造成伤害。
zh.name: 大力士

en.description: Orokin elites admired farmers in conquered regions, because they had learned to fight with modified farming tools despite being forbidden to own weapons. For their voyage, the Zariman were presented with Praedos in recognition of Zariman tenacity. The Void reinforces the strength of the spirited individual by fortifying the Praedos.
en.name: Praedos

zh.description: 奥罗金精英很佩服那些被征服地区的农夫，他们在武器禁令的压制下学会了通过改良的农具来进行战斗。当「扎里曼号」启航时，船上的人们获得了双雄以表彰他们坚韧不拔的精神。虚空通过增强双雄的力量来奖励使用该武器的人。
zh.name: 双雄

en.description: During parades and victory marches, the Laetum fired pigmented airburst rounds that rained onto festive crowds. The Orokin sent Laetum with the Zariman so they could properly celebrate a successful maiden voyage to Tau. There would be no such celebration, but the Void imbued the Laetum with a much more explosive capacity.
en.name: Laetum

zh.description: 在阅兵式和得胜行军期间，人们会用奏凯发射色彩缤纷的空爆弹化作鲜艳的雨点落在欢庆的人群身上。奥罗金人将奏凯送上了「扎里曼号」，以便他们能够好好庆祝前往陶星系的成功首航。虽然这样的庆祝活动从未发生，但虚空给奏凯赋予了更强的爆炸之力。
zh.name: 奏凯

en.description: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this fist weapon. In Incarnon form, perform Heavy Slams to impale nearby enemies with spikes.
en.name: Ruvox

zh.description: 阿尔布雷希特的虚空实验揭示了这把拳套武器的真正破坏潜力。在灵化形态下，使用重型震地攻击会以尖刺刺穿附近的敌人。
zh.name: 古声

en.description: Wield the timeless power of this mighty hammer. Heavy Attacks performed with Ekhein temporarily increase its Damage and Attack Speed.
en.name: Ekhein

zh.description: 掌控这把强大战锤的永恒力量。使用映声战锤进行的重击会暂时增加其伤害和攻击速度。
zh.name: 映声战锤

en.description: Albrecht's Void experiments revealed the true destructive potential of this weapon. In Incarnon form, draw in ambient power to deal steadily increased damage to enemies. At full power, release a blast of <DT_FIRE_COLOR>Heat.
en.name: Onos

zh.description: 阿尔布雷希特的虚空实验揭示了这把武器的真正破坏潜力。在灵化形态下，吸收周围的能量对敌人造成逐渐增加的伤害。当能量充满时，释放一股 <DT_FIRE_COLOR>火焰爆炸。
zh.name: 赘骨

en.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. This large, weighty double-barreled pistol delivers twin projectiles that pack a punch, exploding on impact. Secondary fire puts the weapon in lock-on mode. Aim to lock onto multiple targets, then fire to unleash homing projectiles.
en.name: Sepulcrum

zh.description: 一把由英择谛所设计的古老武器。主要射击模式可从目标身上吸取生命精华，以助燃次要射击模式带来的毁灭性攻击。这把大且沉的双管手枪可发出双股投射弹药，并在撞击时产生强力爆炸。次要射击模式会将手枪置于锁定状态，可追踪多个目标，并释放制导弹药。
zh.name: 追击者

en.description: An ancient weapon designed by the Entrati. Primary fire siphons life essence from the target to fuel a devastating secondary fire. A heavy, oversized automatic rifle with withering fire that delivers rapid heat damage. Secondary fire unleashes an arcing projectile that ricochets off surfaces and enemies, exploding on every impact.
en.name: Trumna

zh.description: 一把由英择谛所设计的古老武器。主要射击模式可从目标身上吸取生命精华，以助燃次要射击模式带来的毁灭性攻击。这把具有毁灭级火力的重型超大号自动步枪可迅速造成火焰伤害。次要射击模式可呈弧线抛射出一枚跳射弹丸，每次撞击到物体表面和敌人都会造成爆炸伤害。
zh.name: 灭杀者

en.description: Encased in plates refined from pure prisma crystals, this rare element gives this assault rifle a radiant luster.
en.name: Prisma Grakata

zh.description: 这把突击步枪镀上了一层纯净的棱晶，此种稀有元素赋予它闪耀动人的光泽。
zh.name: 棱晶·葛拉卡达

en.description: Forged from raw prisma crystals and infused with Void energy, this blade's pristine edge is honed razor-sharp to eviscerate even the most deadly of foes.
en.name: Prisma Skana

zh.description: 这把空刃是由原生棱晶所锻造而成，并注入了虚空能量，千锤百炼下其纯净的刀锋即便是最致命的敌人都能大卸八块。
zh.name: 棱晶·空刃

en.description: For Orokin-era smugglers, this fearsome handheld shotgun was a favored tool for 'dispute resolution'.
en.name: Mara Detron

zh.description: 对于奥罗金时代的走私者来说，这把令人生畏的手持式霰弹枪是最受他们青睐用来"解决纠纷"的工具。
zh.name: 苦痛·德特昂
